title: Customer Contract Coordinator – Italian and English Speaker
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Join our Offer and Contracting Operations Team as a Contract Coordinator with Italian and English and play an important role in supporting commercial success in a dynamic, international environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with contracts, pricing, and business processes, while collaborating across teams and markets. In this role, you will support Sales Representatives by creating and managing deals in Vendavo, ensuring pricing accuracy, data transparency, and compliance with established guidelines.
Working closely with the Italian & UK Team, as well as Sales and Pricing teams, you will contribute to seamless deal execution, price continuity, and high-quality data across systems. As part of a business-critical function, you will help drive efficient and compliant contract coordination processes while building valuable expertise in a fast-paced, multinational organization.


Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Create, update, and manage pricing deals in internal tools, including Vendavo, in line with approved guidelines and business requirements.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance across systems such as Vendavo, SAP, and ServiceNow, safeguarding the integrity and confidentiality of pricing and contract data.
  • Support Sales Representatives by preparing customer-ready offers, pricing documentation, reports, and other contract-related materials.
  • Manage the team mailbox on a day-to-day basis, ensuring queries are handled, distributed, and tracked in a timely manner through internal systems.
  • Maintain customer pricing e-catalogues and price files in cooperation with Operations and E-commerce teams, ensuring all information is accurate, up to date, and aligned with customer requirements.
  • Prepare, compile, and upload contractual and ad hoc customer reports, investigate pricing discrepancies, and support audit activities, including documentation and reporting requests.
  • Monitor performance against SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve process efficiency and support operational decision-making through analysis.

Required Knowledge and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Italian and English language proficiency at B2 level or higher
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in pricing, analytics, finance, or other process-driven operational roles
  • Ability to work efficiently across multiple systems and tools
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and work efficiently across multiple systems and tools
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong and credible relationships with stakeholders at all levels

title: Production Worker - Copper Dip/Powder Coat
description:
As a top player in Switchgear and E-house Manufacturing and field servicing, a career with us will challenge you to solve some very tough problems. You will be rewarded with growth, personal development & industry expertise. At Powell, we provide a comprehensive salary package, RRSP matching, extensive benefits and job training all within a professional & friendly working environment.

Based out of the Electrical Division Edmonton (EDE) location, the Production Worker will report to the Manufacturing Supervisor of the Fabrication department. The Production Worker will use a variety of skills and tools to produce precision parts and construct Powell Canada products.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Assist with daily and weekly preventative maintenance of the metal working machinery.
  • Masking and taping parts in the Powder Coating and Copper Dip department
  • Move parts from one manufacturing operation to the next, according to the part routing.
  • Loading and unloading of steel or other product from trucks (indoor/outdoor).
  • Assist with shop and yard organization.
  • Assist machine operators with various tasks upon request.
  • Remove finished parts from sheet metal skeletons.
  • De-burring, grinding or finishing of metal parts using all types of air/electric grinders or sanders.
  • Sort and stack parts by part number & job number combination.
  • Assemble kits of parts to be welded.
  • Operate pallet jack, forklift and cranes.
  • Knowledge and ability to use general hand tools such as hammers, screwdrivers, wrenches, vise grips, etc.
  • On occasion, required to perform labor tasks such as painting, grinding, sanding or general cleaning tasks as directed by Supervisor or Lead Person.
  • Promote a safety culture as well as attend all safety meetings.
  • Ensures quality by following standard work instructions and identifying any potential risks to product quality.
  • Ensure work area remains clean and well organized.
  • Other duties as required.

Core Competencies

  • Ability to read a tape measure (including conversions from fraction to decimal and conversely from decimal to fraction and metric to imperial).
  • Conscientious, thorough, accurate, and reliable when performing and completing job tasks.
  • Ability to learn and adhere to all manufacturing policies and practices to ensure adherence to ISO requirements.
  • Able to work effectively within a team and around other departments and their activities.
  • Must have a basic command of the English language, both written and verbal.

Qualifications

  • Minimum education level of a High School Diploma is required.
  • 1-2 year metal fabrication shop experience is considered an asset.
  • Safety certifications are an asset for this position.

Work Authorization: This is a permanent position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire. Immigration sponsorship is not typically available and will be considered only where supported by business needs and applicable legal requirements.

Working Conditions

  • Working with hot temperatures.
  • Safety sensitive position in a temperature controlled manufacturing or industrial environment with occasional outside activities.
  • Required to wear personnel protective equipment at all times (i.e., hard hats, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety harnesses as required) and respirators when required.
  • Must be able to work from all type of ladders (step ladders, "A" frame ladders and all size extension ladders) and scaffolding.
  • Working at heights usually no higher than 30 feet in the air on or using proper lift equipment.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to maintain body equilibrium and agility to prevent falling when walking, standing, crouching, ascending or descending stairs.
  • Bending the body at the waist, the legs at the knees, and extending arms and hands in any direction in a repetitive manner continuously.
  • Continuous standing, walking 50-300 foot distances for long periods of time with only occasional sitting.
  • Must be able to climb stairs frequently throughout the shift.
  • Able to frequently look over shoulders, work with both arms above shoulders and use both arms at full length frequently.
  • Using upper extremities to apply or exert a force continuously up to 50lbs.
  • Ability to use hand tools such as tin snips, hammer, and power tools (some vibrating), for long periods of time with frequent repetition.

Who we are

Powell Canada Inc. is a subsidiary of Powell Industries, which is located in Houston, Texas. Globally, we have over 70 years of experience. Powell Canada is a reputable electrical manufacturing and electrical/instrumentation contracting company. We hold a strong industry presence with offices located in Acheson, Calgary and Montreal.

Powell strives to create one unified company through training, communication and leadership. We offer diversified services based on our customer’s needs, keeping us on the cutting edge of new products and services within our industry.

Your Partner in Safety

Successful candidates must have legal authorization to work in Canada on a full-time basis for any employer, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Powell Canada, Inc is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Lead Infrastructure Software Engineer
description:
We build and support new and existing critical infrastructural systems and frameworks that provide services like structured and unstructured storage, caching, queueing, searching, and much more at hyperscale. These form the platform upon which many iCloud and other backend systems at Apple are built. The team is responsible for the next-generation platform that will power Apple's infrastructural services. These services operate at extremely large scale and store exabytes of data. The platform supports a variety of services based on open-source software, such as Kubernetes, Cassandra, Zookeeper, Kafka, Redis, etc., alongside internally developed services.

We are looking for a creative, versatile, and passionate engineer to join this group. You will have significant individual responsibility and influence over the direction the core platform takes for years to come. You will create API-driven services with extraordinary precision, delightful features, and resilient designs that "just work." Your engineering will impact hundreds of millions of users and be essential to the success of some of the most visible current and future Apple features.

The successful candidate must have experience in software development, distributed systems, and technical leadership. They must have experience technically leading projects or small teams to deliver on time in fast-changing environments, including working across multiple timezones to deliver and launch production-impacting projects.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a backend internet services software engineer in a high-level language such as Golang (preferred), C++, Java, or Python.
  • Successful track-record and proven experience of leading projects from design to launch, using business needs to determine velocity and scope.
  • Deep understanding of multi-threading concepts and design of highly concurrent and distributed applications.
  • Understanding of distributed system concepts including the CAP Theorem, microservices, and self-healing architectures.
  • Knowledge of SDLC, including continuous integration, testing methodologies, TDD, and agile development.
  • Understanding of infrastructure foundational concepts such as containerization, virtualization, and agents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident review processes for production services.
  • Experience with development within the Kubernetes ecosystem, including operator framework and controllers.
  • Exposure to structured or unstructured storage or caching layers such as Cassandra, Redis, or Memcache.
  • Experience with large-scale server orchestration (OpenStack Ironic, Metal3, MAAS, xCat, Netbox, Tinkerbell, Cloudstack).
  • Experience with UI frameworks such as React, Angular or JQuery
  • Exposure to cloud services (AWS S3/EC2/CloudFront/Steps or equivalent).
  • Exposure to server bootstrap and associated security (PXE, BIOS, TPM, secure boot, trusted computing)
  • Exposure to configuration management and fleet orchestration via Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or similar.

title: Sleep Technologist
description:
Job Summary

The Sleep Technologist is responsible for administering sleep studies under the direction of a physician to diagnose the type and extent of sleep disorders. This role involves conducting routine patient assessments, scoring sleep records accurately, documenting results, and collecting and transmitting biological specimens for analysis.

Essential Functions

  • Conducts sleep studies in accordance with established protocols and under the direction of a Medical Director, ensuring patient safety and comfort throughout the procedure.
  • Performs and documents comprehensive patient assessments prior to and during sleep studies, addressing patient needs and monitoring physiological data.
  • Scores sleep records accurately, adhering to guidelines and standards, and communicates findings to physicians for diagnostic evaluation.
  • Collects and transmits biological specimens for analysis, following proper procedures and maintaining sample integrity.
  • Documents test results and patient data thoroughly, ensuring compliance with departmental policies and regulatory standards.
  • Maintains and calibrates sleep study equipment, troubleshooting and reporting any malfunctions to ensure effective operation.
  • Provides patient education about sleep studies and explains procedures, promoting understanding and comfort.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in sleep technology or a related field required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proficient in scoring sleep studies and interpreting physiological data.
  • Strong patient care and assessment skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Knowledge of sleep study equipment and maintenance procedures.

Licenses and Certifications

  • RPSGT - Registered Polysomnographic Technologist required or
  • CPSGT - Certified Polysomnographic Technician required
  • BCLS - Basic Life Support required

title: Security Engineer (Full Remote - Slovakia)
description:

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
DEPARTMENT Engineering

LOCATION Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid)

TYPE Full time

REPORTS TO CTO

THE ROLE

Enterprises come to Blank Metal to get production AI live. That work is led by senior people who can sit across from a client's executives, diagnose the real problem, and then go build the thing that fixes it.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer you'll turn advisory conversations into shipped software, closing the gap between a promising demo and a system that runs in production, where most enterprise AI initiatives stall. You embed with a client, earn trust at the executive level, and stay hands-on from the first scoping session through the live deployment. You are equal parts technical leader and trusted advisor: you shape what gets built, you build it with a lean team of AI engineers, and you own whether it actually works in production.

The playbook for this practice is still being written, and you will write a lot of it: how we embed, how we prove value, and what we bring back from each engagement.

Forward deployed means what it says. Expect roughly 25 to 40% travel to client sites, heavier during kickoffs and go-lives. The rest of the time you work wherever you work best.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role with real ownership: you carry a small number of accounts deeply, and you are measured on outcomes clients can see.

WHAT YOU GET TO DO

Set the conditions

  • Partner with client executives to find the highest-value AI opportunity, then frame it in the client's own language

  • Lead scoping and proof of concept work that de-risks the build before a full engagement starts

  • Shape the technical approach and scope alongside our growth team; they own the close, you make sure what's promised is what can actually be built

Build it for real

  • Deploy alongside a lean team of AI engineers and own the architecture, the hard calls, and the code that ships

  • Deliver the concrete artifacts clients run in production: MCP servers, sub-agents, agent skills, and the pipelines around them

  • Work across the full stack and the model layer

  • Navigate real enterprise environments: the client's IT systems, security constraints, and the stakeholders who own them

Own the outcome

  • Stand behind results with observability and evals the client can check for themselves

  • Win over the people who use the system day to day; a deployment succeeds when they rely on it

  • Carry accounts end-to-end: some weeks are executive workshops, some weeks are debugging and agentic orchestration

  • Bring patterns back to the team so the next engagement starts further ahead

WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED

  • Typically 7+ years building and shipping software, including real time as a technical leader who executives actually trusted

  • A track record of owning production systems end-to-end, from first commit through live operation

  • You have shipped LLM-powered systems to production: agents, retrieval, evals, and the judgment to know when each is the wrong tool

  • Strong hands-on skills in Python and TypeScript or JavaScript, and comfort picking up whatever the client's stack demands

  • You have built or maintained eval frameworks that showed whether a system actually worked

  • You can hold your own with a CTO in the morning and be in the codebase in the afternoon

  • At home with ambiguity and a small team: you would rather figure it out than wait for a playbook

  • A straightforward communicator who explains hard technical calls in plain language

  • Low ego, high cooperation: you balance competing priorities with integrity and make the people around you better

  • You have been a founder, CTO, or first engineer building a product or startup and know what it costs to get something live.

  • Bonus: depth in healthcare or private equity, where much of our current work lives

If this role sounds like you but you don't check every box, apply anyway. We care more about what you've shipped than how the resume reads.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

  • Build AI that ships

  • Shape the practice: the way Blank Metal does forward deployment will carry your fingerprints

  • Craft meets velocity: we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed

  • Outcome-driven model: our work aligns with client success, not billable hours

  • AI-native culture: you'll work with peers who deeply understand modern AI's potential and limits

  • Real collaboration: open conversations, shared ownership, and space to bring your voice

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

This role pays a base salary commensurate with experience, plus a revenue-based variable comp structure tied to the accounts you carry: when your clients win and the company grows, your comp grows with it. We offer comprehensive health coverage, 401(k) with match, flexible time off, flexible work arrangements, and support for professional development.

ABOUT BLANK METAL

Blank Metal is an AI-native engineering company that partners with enterprises to deliver production AI fast. We blend strategic insight with hands-on execution, shipping high-impact systems that turn AI initiatives into measurable business results.

We're builders, not theorists. Our team of seasoned engineers, designers, and strategists work across industries to create AI applications that actually get used and make a difference.

Blank Metal is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all backgrounds and perspectives. Diversity makes our work better and our team stronger.

title: Developer, Open Source
description:

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking an Intermediate Developer on our Open Source Team, focused on strengthening 1Password's open source posture and making our developer tools easy to use directly inside developers' workflows through agentic IDE integrations: our Agent Hooks and IDE plugins. You'll participate in the complete lifecycle of a feature, contributing to planning, doing the development work, and seeing it through release and customer support, while consistently delivering projects within the team.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • Professional software development experience, with the ability to take a reasonably scoped feature from plan to release with a high degree of independence.

  • Working knowledge of the technologies and tools needed to complete tasks independently.

  • Solid experience with a modern development toolchain (Git, IDEs, terminal, debugging and testing, dependency management) and the languages relevant to the team's work.

  • Good written communication and documentation habits, suited to working in public repositories.

  • Interest in developer tooling, IDE and agent integrations, and/or open source community work.

  • Interest in agent-assisted development and building tools to make agent-assisted development smoother and more secure.

  • A security-conscious mindset aligned with 1Password's principles.

Bonus points for:

  • Prior contributions to open source projects.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled or agentic IDEs (e.g., Cursor) or building editor/IDE extensions.

What you can expect:

  • Acquire and maintain a solid understanding of your development toolchain and use it to contribute new features, improvements, and bug fixes across the team's codebases.

  • Participate in the complete lifecycle of a feature: contribute to planning, do the development, and help oversee its release and customer support.

  • Ensure code is high quality and maintainable by developing new testing strategies in addition to existing ones, writing unit and integration tests for new and existing code, documenting your work thoroughly, and reporting issues effectively.

  • Plan your solutions ahead of writing code, recognize and reuse existing patterns and best practices (development, security, quality), and submit well-documented merge requests.

  • Participate in and review documented proposals (RFCs/RFDs), promote best practices in code reviews, and provide thoughtful peer feedback.

  • Empower our customer support team to better support our products, address tough issues driving support inflows, and help determine high-priority customer feedback.

  • Be an active participant in team organization: refinement, prioritization, and group estimation.

  • Be curious and on the lookout for improvement opportunities you can suggest or tackle yourself, whether in repo cleanup, community engagement tooling, or IDE integration ergonomics.

title: Specjalista(-ka) / Starszy(-a) Specjalista(-ka) ds. korporacyjnych produktów kredytowych
description:
To masz na bank:

  • umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 12 miesięcy),
  • praca w modelu hybrydowym (częściowo w biurze w Warszawie, Plac Europejski 3A – The Bridge),
  • zespół/lider: Zespół Obsługi Finansowania Strukturyzowanego i Korporacyjnego Premium, Joanna Umiastowska | LinkedIn - śmiało sprawdź z kim możesz pracować,
  • cel roli: kompleksowa obsługa i administracja portfelem transakcji kredytowych poprzez zapewnienie prawidłowej realizacji umów, wsparcie procesów kredytowych oraz bieżącą współpracę z klientami i instytucjami finansowymi.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym. Choć jesteśmy zupełnie różni to mamy jeden cel - wszystko robimy na bank. Mamy też możliwość integracji z innymi pracownikami np. dzięki ponad 20 Klubom Zainteresowań.
Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • bezpośredni kontakt z klientami, bankami, kancelariami prawnymi, mającymi siedzibę zarówno w kraju, jak i poza w ramach przypisanego portfela transakcji kredytowych w zakresie realizacji zapisów umów kredytowych,
  • realizacja zadań wynikających z zapisów umów na wzorach bankowych lub LMA, bilateralnych i konsorcjalnych,
  • prowadzenie Agentur w transakcjach konsorcjalnych,
  • obsługa posprzedażowa umów kredytowych, w tym m.in.: kompletowanie warunków uruchomienia środków, monitoring, aneksowanie, waivery itp.,
  • administracja dokumentacją,
  • wsparcie uczestników procesu kredytowego w zakresie dokumentacyjnym oraz operacyjnym,
  • poszukiwanie i proponowanie najlepszych rozwiązań i usprawnień w procesie obsługi klienta,
  • udział w projektach dotyczących inicjatyw i usprawnień procesów,
  • realizacja umów escrow, udział w negocjacjach treści zapisów i struktury transakcji.

Aplikuj do nas, jeśli:

  • masz wykształcenie wyższe (ekonomiczne, prawnicze, finanse i bankowość),
  • posiadasz minimum 2-letnie doświadczenie w pracy w banku lub w instytucjach finansowych,
  • masz doświadczenia w obsłudze dokumentacji kredytowej, znajomość dokumentacji LMA,
  • posiadasz wiedzę w zakresie procesów kredytowych,
  • odznaczasz się umiejętnościami analitycznymi, samodzielnością, zaangażowaniem, inicjatywą i odpornością na stres,
  • umiesz pracować w zespole,
  • jesteś dokładny(-a) i terminowy(-a),
  • posiadasz znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie średniozaawansowanym / komunikatywnym.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę;
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym;
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego);
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego;
  • kartę Multisport;
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach;
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony;
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci;
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala;
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne.


Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?
Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań. Przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach:
1. Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.
2. Spotkaj się (online) z rekruterem/-ką i managerem/-ką.
3. Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania.
Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Dispatcher
description:
Your role at Veezu:

As a Dispatcher in our Journey Booking Centre, you will work in partnership with Driver Partners and our external JBC Partners to ensure bookings are dispatched efficiently so that passengers are transported on time. You will maximise Driver Partner completion rates through efficient management of the dispatch of inbound bookings and good communication with Driver Partners.

Reporting into the Team Manager or JBC Manager, your role will involve optimising Driver Partner and resource capacity, helping our Off-Shore Booking Agents to keep our Passengers updated and giving the Driver Partners a great experience.

Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What you’ll do:

QUALITY DELIVERY AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

  • Develop a deep knowledge and understanding of the local Driver Partner community - their needs, concerns and behaviours – become someone that they trust.

  • Take responsibility for understanding, meeting and exceeding your objectives and set KPIs

  • Allocate and dispatch journeys on the Dispatch booking system, communicating positively, politely, professionally and precisely with Driver Partners via the messaging service/telephone as and when required.

  • Manage passenger demand to ensure bookings run on time and use the zone controller tool and wait time wallboard (if applicable) effectively. Feedback any delays to Offshore Booking as required.

  • Arrange bookings for walk-in passengers where applicable at regional hubs.

  • Liaise with off-shore partners in respect of handling passenger queries and bookings.

  • Respond to Driver Partner alerts and Driver Partner queries via the telephone and / or Dispatch driver chat in a timely, courteous and professional manner.

  • Assist Driver Partners with complex queries or directing them to the Driver Partner portal and / or messaging service.

  • Demonstrate excellence in the handling of passenger bookings, mainly related to our high value and commercial account journeys and passenger care queries

  • Ensure specific or set instructions for account customer journey bookings are communicated and processed accordingly.

  • Ensure service delivery to commercial account customers is efficient and well managed at all times.

  • Ensure transferring of calls is kept to a minimum and avoid blind transferring at all times.

  • Utilise Slack channels, Dispatch messaging and any other relevant internal communication channels throughout your shift to receive any relevant business and / or operational updates.

  • Liaise with other departments such as Veezu Commercial, Veezu IT to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and within agreed SLAs.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary contact, improve policies and processes, increase sales and/ or improve the passenger experience and feed these into your Team Manager.

  • Seek to support passengers, account customers and Driver Partners to self-serve wherever possible.

  • Process all cash, card, account, and app bookings in accordance with company procedures.

  • Encourage the use of AirPay / use of a Driver Partner’s in-car payment machine to reduce call time wherever possible.

  • Manage and keep the zone controller accurate (if applicable) and up to date throughout the shift so that the right information can be provided to Passengers and bookings can be optimised.

SELF-DEVELOPMENT AND COMPLIANCE

  • Ensure completion of all mandatory training.

  • Manage your own self-development to improve knowledge.

  • Proactively prepare for 1:1 meetings and appraisals with Team Manager or JBC Manager.

  • Understand and embody the Veezu values.

  • Constructively challenge, question, seek to improve, evolve and be kind.

  • Contribute to a strong community spirit.

  • Be objective, fair, ethical, and consistent.

  • Ensure fair treatment of customers, passengers, Driver Partners and colleagues and act in a professional manner at all times.

  • Ensure legal and contractual compliance.

  • Maintain regular consistent and professional attendance, punctuality, personal appearance, and adherence to relevant health & safety procedures.

  • Be willing to support other business areas as needed.

  • Adhere to company policies and procedures.

  • Ensure that customer, passenger, Driver Partner and colleagues’ information is safeguarded at all times, in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

  • Be committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.

  • Maintain information security to a recognised required standard in line with business needs

What you’ll need:

  • Ability to deliver excellent customer service.

  • Confidence in speaking to people on the phone.

  • Strong computer skills, including using multiple software platforms collaboratively.

  • Excellent listening and communication skills.

  • Professional and committed.

  • Ability to deal with challenging customer service situations.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to multitask and work under pressure.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Flexibility to work outside of standard working hours.

  • Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.

Where you’ll be:

  • This role will be based out of our Luton hub.

Veezu is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment, welcoming applications from all backgrounds, experiences, and communities.

  1. To understand the operation, safety requirements and restraints of scanning equipment, computer, price-verification equipment and intercom system.

title: Senior Project Manager

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the timely and effective delivery of a portfolio of technology led projects, in support of AJ Bell’s strategic objectives. The role of the Senior Project Manager is to work closely with the Sponsor of the portfolio to identify and prioritise projects within the portfolio and deliver individual projects through the delivery lifecycle; from project entry through to go-live and post implementation. The Senior Project Manager is an SME in their field, able to provide mentorship and management of less experienced Project Managers. Projects are undertaken primarily to deliver technology driven change in support of the evolving technology landscape however given the wider financial backdrop experience of delivering IT change in a financially regulated environment would be an advantage.

What does the job involve?

  • Prioritising and providing guidance on the selection of projects
  • Providing mentorship and/or line management responsibility of less experienced Project Managers
  • Delivering complex IT projects often working with third party suppliers to implement a hybrid of internal and external solutions
  • Establishing and maintaining effective and trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and external third-party suppliers
  • Co-ordinating and driving the collaboration of project resources to get the best from project teams
  • Producing and monitoring resource forecasts and budgets and where change is required, following appropriate change control procedures
  • Regularly reporting on the status and health of the portfolio and individual projects to sponsors and wider stakeholders at all levels of the organisation
  • Effectively managing project risk and dependencies, and assessing for any potential risk to consumer outcomes posed by the project
  • Ensure that all duties are carried out with the aim of protecting customers and improving customer experience
  • Supporting and enabling the business to achieve its regulatory requirements, including consumer duty

Competence, knowledge and skills

  • Strong technical knowledge and experience gained from a technology background
  • An ability to quickly understand technical topics
  • Proficient in the production of Business Cases, Project Initiation Documents and other project documentation
  • Ideally PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
  • Ideally experience of IT development methodologies e.g. Agile, SDLC
  • Experience of delivering in a financially regulated environment desirable
  • Financial services industry knowledge, e.g. pensions, investments and stockbroking, would be beneficial
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Good business/commercial knowledge

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, SLED, Google Public Sector
description:
The Google Public Sector Forward Deployed Engineering (GPS FDE) team squad of "innovator-builders" who rapidly deploy production-grade, secure AI solutions across Federal and SLED environments. Operating with a high-agency startup mindset, our engineers don’t just advise; they actively code, debug, and co-build bespoke agentic workflows directly alongside our customers. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Google Public Sector (GPS), you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as a moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment.

This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will manage blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

This role will be focusing on the State and Local Government Market.

Google Public Sector brings the magic of Google to the mission of government and education with solutions purpose-built for enterprises. title: Third-Party Risk Management Analyst (1 Year Contract)
description:
SUMMARY

Reporting to the Director Strategic Sourcing, the Third-Party Risk Management Analyst supports the Strategic Sourcing function by integrating supplier onboarding, compliance, risk management, and data analytics to enable informed sourcing decisions. The role is responsible for managing end‑to‑end supplier qualification and lifecycle activities while identifying, monitoring, and escalating third‑party risks through due diligence reviews, ongoing compliance tracking, and audit support. A strong emphasis is placed on risk management, including assessment of supplier financial, operational, and regulatory risks, to protect the organization and its clients. The TPRM Analyst works cross‑functionally with Strategic Sourcing, Finance, P2P, IT, Legal, and Client Account teams to resolve issues, align data, and ensure consistent supplier governance across systems. Leveraging advanced data analytics and reporting, the role analyzes supplier spend, and performance trends, translating complex data into actionable insights that support sourcing strategies, supplier performance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

SUPPLIER QUALIFICATION, ONBOARDING & COMPLIANCE

  • Execute end‑to‑end supplier onboarding, changes, and demobilizations in line with policies and SLAs.
  • Process high‑volume supplier setup requests accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Validate supplier documentation, ensure data integrity, and prevent duplicate or non‑compliant entries.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, service providers, and suppliers to complete qualification requirements.
  • Identify compliance issues, manage resolution, and escalate risks or exception requests as required.
  • Support supplier outreach, engagement, and ongoing compliance communications.

THIRD‑PARTY DUE DILIGENCE & RISK MANAGEMENT

  • Conduct supplier due diligence reviews related to onboarding, reactivation, and changes.
  • Review and escalate third‑party risk assessment findings and alerts.
  • Support Anti‑Bribery & Corruption (ABC) reviews and ongoing supplier risk monitoring.
  • Review third‑party risk or credit reports and seek mitigation activities.

REPORTING, ANALYTICS & DATA MANAGEMENT

  • Collect, analyze, and reconcile supplier spend and compliance data by client and category.
  • Prepare and deliver sourcing, compliance, and supply chain reports with a focus on data accuracy.
  • Support audit through providing required documents

SYSTEMS, TOOLS & CROSS‑FUNCTIONAL SUPPORT

  • Utilize sourcing, procurement, and reporting systems to support onboarding, compliance, and analytics.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Sourcing, P2P, IT, Finance, Legal, and Client Account teams to resolve issues.
  • Support system enhancements, testing, and continuous improvement of sourcing and reporting tools.

OTHER DUTIES

  • Resolve and support supplier data discrepancies and compliance concerns.
  • Support onboarding new team members
  • Contribute to process improvements, documentation, and governance initiatives.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • College diploma in business or other relevant program.
  • 3-5 years related experience.
  • Bilingual in English and French (written and spoken) preferred.
  • Computer proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Proficiency with Oracle or RealSuite application is an asset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent business writing skills, technical writing skills an asset.
  • Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal).
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to multi-task under deadline pressure.

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $54,185 - $67,732 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

title: Extension Specialist I, 4H Youth Development - UTIA
description:
The Extension Specialist I position provides statewide leadership for Tennessee 4-H citizenship and leadership programs, teen programming, and international exchange opportunities. Responsibilities include planning, implementing, and evaluating educational programs and leadership experiences that develop civic engagement, workforce readiness, and global awareness among youth. The position collaborates with Extension personnel, volunteers, and partners to coordinate statewide events, leadership initiatives, and educational opportunities that support the mission and long-term goals of the Tennessee 4-H program.

Teen Programming and Leadership Events:

  • Coordinate statewide teen leadership programs and events including Tennessee 4-H Congress, Roundup, All Star Conference, leadership summits, ambassador programs, and other statewide teen initiatives.

  • Provide oversight for educational content, event logistics, officer training, youth engagement strategies, and program evaluation.

Citizenship and Leadership Program Development:

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate statewide citizenship, leadership, and teen programs.

  • Create educational resources and provide training and support for Extension agents, volunteers, and youth leaders to strengthen program delivery and youth engagement across the state.

International Exchange and Global Education Programs:

  • Coordinate statewide international exchange opportunities and global education initiatives including inbound and outbound exchanges, cultural immersion experiences, host family recruitment and support, and youth preparation activities.

  • Maintain partnerships with international organizations and ensure compliance with university and risk management policies.

Partnerships and Resource Development:

  • Build partnerships with universities, agencies, organizations, and community stakeholders while identifying grant and funding opportunities to expand statewide 4-H programs.

Training and Technical Assistance:

  • Provide training, teaching, and technical support to Extension agents, volunteers, and partners through workshops, conferences, webinars, and other professional development opportunities.

Program Evaluation and Reporting:

  • Conduct needs assessments, evaluate program outcomes, and analyze data to improve programs, demonstrate impact, and inform statewide priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Requires a Master's degree in Education, Agriculture, Family & Consumer Sciences, or a closely related field.

  • Experience: Substantial work experience which demonstrates promise in teaching, Extension and/or service in alignment with the appointment.

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

    • Knowledge of 4-H youth development programming

    • Willingness to travel statewide and work evenings and weekends as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: PhD. in Education, Agriculture, Family & Consumer Sciences, or a closely related field.

  • Experience: Experience with program evaluation, assessment, reporting, data management, and securing external funding to strengthen programs, demonstrate impact, and support continuous improvement.

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

    • Strong organizational, communication, relationship-building, and project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple statewide youth programs, leadership initiatives, and events.

    • Ability to develop, deliver, and evaluate educational programs, curricula, professional development, and in-service training while collaborating effectively with Extension agents, volunteers, youth, faculty, partners, and stakeholders.

    • Knowledge of teen leadership development and international exchange or global education programs

Work Location

  • Location: Knoxville, TN - hybrid

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: Starting salary based on education & experience

  • Find more information on the UT Market Range structure here

  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

To express interest, please submit an application with the noted below attachments. To be assured of full consideration, completed applications with all requested materials should be submitted on or before August 10th, 2026.

  • Resume

  • Cover Letter

  • List of 3 Professional References

About The College/Department/Division

UT Extension provides a gateway to the University of Tennessee as the outreach unit of the Institute of Agriculture. It is a statewide educational organization, funded by federal, state and local governments, that brings research-based information about agriculture, family and consumer sciences, and resource development to the people of Tennessee where they live and work.


4-H is the youth development program of UT Extension. Preparing young people to become responsible, capable, and involved leaders and citizens of Tennessee, and the nation, is the goal of the 4-H program. The goal is accomplished by providing educational experiences for young people to gain knowledge, develop life skills, live healthy lives, make intelligent career choices, and form positive attitudes—values young people will rely on throughout their lives. Tennessee 4-H, a component of the Tennessee Extension system, is a leader in youth development education that accomplishes the following:

  • Works with all eligible youth to provide effective, enjoyable learning experiences.
  • Develops unity in all types of family structures.

title: Registered Early Childhood Educator
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Incumbent will perform all, some or similar range of duties as below:

Child Development and Care:

  • Adhere to all requirements of an RECE as determined by The College of Early Childhood Educators and the CCEYA
  • Use a variety of observation and documentation techniques.
  • Facilitate cognitive, language, social, emotional, creative, and physical development of children and acceptance of diversity.
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate age-appropriate program.
  • Research the provincial Curriculum framework.
  • Support the holistic development of all children.
  • Build meaningful relationships with the children.
  • Identify and expand upon learning opportunities (teachable moments).
  • Identify and support child’s individual learning and development.
  • Identify and support diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Meet health, welfare and safety needs.
  • Administer medication and/or procedures. Accommodate for children’s allergies.
  • Implement preventative health and safety measures.
  • Develop and implement safe travelling and off-site practices while providing adequate supervision during these times.
  • Provide first-aid/CPR. Protect children from physical and emotional harm.
  • Implement emergency and evacuation plan.
  • Review safety related issues.
  • Follow safe toileting and diapering procedures.
  • Identify and report suspected cases of child abuse and neglect.
  • Promote a healthy lifestyle and actively supervise children. Promote healthy eating and proper food serving techniques.
  • Meet nutritional needs.
  • Accommodate for special nutritional requirements. Model and teach proper table manners.
  • Establish with colleagues an environment to foster positive behaviour in the program.
  • Guide and observe children. Implement positive behaviour guidance.
  • Facilitate appropriate language, conflict resolution, empathy, problem-solving and coping skills.
  • Use and promote active listening skills.
  • Adhere to all requirements of an RECE as determined by The College of Early Childhood Educators, CCEYA Act and Local Public Health requirements.

Equipment & Facilities:

  • Develop and maintain a safe environment.
  • Check for physical hazards and report hazards to the Supervisor, Assistant
  • Maintain and implement safety standards and protocols.
  • Use developmentally appropriate equipment.
  • Adapt programming and equipment to unique settings and situations.
  • Operate and maintain facilities.
  • Maintain equipment, materials and furnishings.
  • Maintain indoor and outdoor physical environment.
  • Monitor cleanliness and sanitation of all areas used by children as per policy and guidelines.

Family and Community Relations:

  • Form collaborative partnerships with families.
  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with families.
  • Orient families to the program.
  • Communicate and collaborate with families.
  • Provide family resources.
  • Use Community resources.
  • Access and engage community resources, facilities and services.
  • Raise awareness of community events.
  • Advocate for children and families.
  • Make connections between families and resources and respect the rights of the child.
  • Provide an inclusive environment.
  • Collaborate with parents to identify strengths, needs and interests of the child, develop and implement inclusion plans with other professionals and parents.

Record Keeping

  • Maintain records for legislation and regulations and all other required records (daily and monthly attendance, accidents, incidents and occurrences, cleaning procedures, medical procedures and the administration of medication, children’s records, facility maintenance and safety checks).
  • Attendance at parent meetings, staff meetings and other job-related activities will be part and parcel of this job description and the agreed salary.

Fulfill all other related duties as assigned.

CRITICAL RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT:

Governance Boards and Councils: None.

Internal: Staff members, volunteers, children in the program.

External: Parents and guardians of the children, Regulatory agencies, Ministry of Education and Public Health

MANAGERIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

• Reports directly to Childcare Center Supervisor.

• Direct reports: none.

FINANCIAL AND MATERIALS MANAGEMENT:

  • Minor level of material responsibilities (proper use and safekeeping of toys, equipment, etc.).
  • Uses or maintains organization assets in accordance with established guidelines.
  • Does not process any financial transactions/no budget responsibilities.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • The performance of the job requires frequently lifting/moving equipment and children, room set-up, moderate amount of teaching, leading etc.
  • Occasional work on the tablet/iPad.
  • Possibility of intervening in physical confrontations
  • Cleaning the facility and putting up wall displays.
  • The incumbent is required to lift up to 30 pounds with no assistance from others.
  • Shifts and outside work including monthly staff meetings after hours.
  • Exposure to communicable diseases and bodily fluids.
  • Verbal Abuse
  • Tantrums
  • Noise
  • The incumbent may have little to no travel required.

The above responsibilities must be discharged in accordance with The Salvation Army’s Mission Statement, in a professional manner, upholding our code of conduct.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS:

Education, Qualifications and Certifications:

  • ECE Diploma
  • Registered with the College of ECE in Good Standing
  • Knows and complies with the Child Care and Early Years Act and How Does Learning Happen
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Excellent Oral & written communication skills required to work with children, parents and other staff
  • Criminal Reference Check with Vulnerable Sector Screening completed
  • Updated Medical completed
  • Standard First Aid & Level C CPR
  • Complete all on-line Salvation Army courses
  • Food Handlers Certificate an asset
  • Valid Driver’s License and access to a vehicle an asset (travel to multiple locations)
  • Alternative combinations of education and experience may be considered.

Experience and Skilled Knowledge Requirements

  • A minimum of one year of related experience.
  • Knowledge and experience in supervising and implementing programs and completing evaluations related to programming.

Skills and Capabilities

  • Willingness to develop an understanding and support for the mission and purpose of The Salvation Army in Canada and its implications as related to position responsibilities.
  • Work in compliance with OH&S Act and Regulations and abide by The Salvation Army’s health and safety policies and procedures.
  • Review of Criminal Record Check with Vulnerable Sector is required within 6 months of date of issue.
  • Clearance through internal Salvation Army child abuse registry.
  • The Salvation Army Armatus abuse training and Health and Safety training must be completed immediately upon hiring.
  • Demonstrates an active interest and attitude suitable for working with large groups of children.
  • Ensure all Centre policies are read upon hiring and reviewed whenever changed or annually thereafter.
  • Ability to put children at ease and create a warm and friendly environment in which a child can develop fully.
  • Ability to communicate in a kind, peaceful manner.
  • Ability to stay calm and patient.
  • Ability to work with a minimum of supervision.
  • Ability to conduct self professionally and follow policies and procedures and use code of ethics to guide practice.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Maintain required professional certifications and/or registrations and keep up to date with legislative requirements.
  • Maintain a work/life balance.
  • Engage in on-going self-assessment.
  • Maintain physical health and mental well-being.
  • Participate in professional development, a minimum of 8 hours per year.

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $24.47 to $30.59 with a maximum of $36.71.

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

The Salvation Army will provide reasonable accommodation upon request. Please email Recruitment.Accommodations@salvationarmy.ca if you have a need for any accommodation and we will be pleased to discuss this with you.

title: ekspert(-ka) relacji z klientem
description:
To masz na bank:

  • ​​​​​​umowa na zastępstwo,

  • pracę stacjonarną w 3 Oddziale w Krakowie, ul. Pawia 24,

  • zespół/lider: Tomasz Gaik,

  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premia w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom najlepsze doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Dbamy
o portfele klientów w ponad 300 oddziałach w całej Polsce. Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,

  • masz ponad 3-letnie doświadczenie w bankowości i sprzedaży usług i produktów bankowych, w tym produktów inwestycyjnych,

  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,

  • lubisz stawiać sobie ambitne cele i dobrze czujesz się wiedząc do czego dążysz,

  • czujesz się komfortowo zarówno w pracy indywidualnej jak i zespołowej,

  • chcesz się rozwijać w bankowości i zdobywać nowe kompetencje zgodnie z wybraną specjalizacją z zakresu Klient Zamożny, Hipoteka, MŚP,

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych,

  • doświadczenie w sprzedaży produktów inwestycyjnych (w tym funduszy),

  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • obsługę bardziej wymagających potrzeb klienta oraz wsparcie w wyborze najlepszych produktów i usług bankowych,

  • zapewnienie profesjonalnej obsługi oraz najlepszych doświadczeń związanych z wizytą w oddziale,

  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych,

  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych zadań sprzedażowych, za które przyznajemy miesięczne premie na atrakcyjnym poziomie,

  • telefoniczny i bezpośredni kontakt z klientami,

  • budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami oraz pozyskiwanie nowych,

  • praca w zgodzie z obowiązującymi procedurami oraz standardami dotyczącymi i realizowanymi we wszystkich kanałach dystrybucji.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),

  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),

  • ubezpieczenie na życie,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),

  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,

  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,

  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,

  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,

  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),

  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,

  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.

  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i otrzymywać pierwsze premie.

  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.

  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

1. wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,

2. spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,

3. pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Senior Specialist, POM Product Owner (APAC AI Hub)
description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Specialist, POM Product Owner to join our AI Hub team. This role is located in Singapore.

The role combines product ownership, solution delivery, stakeholder management, and AI domain knowledge to ensure AI-enabled solutions progress efficiently from concept through production adoption. Focus areas may include Digital Employees, Instruction Capture, Instruction Repair, workflow automation, enterprise copilots, model evaluation frameworks, and AI-enabled operational transformation initiatives.

This position provides an opportunity to work at the center of AI innovation within BNY while developing expertise in AI product delivery, enterprise-scale implementation, responsible AI practices, and operational transformation.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Own and actively manage portions of AI Hub product backlogs, ensuring alignment to business priorities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Translate business and operational challenges into well-defined product requirements, user stories, and scalable workflows.
  • Partner with Product Managers, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, and Operations teams to support requirements gathering, testing, and release planning.
  • Contribute to the delivery of AI-enabled solutions from early-stage experimentation through pilot and production rollout.
  • Support the development and implementation of Generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation solutions across business areas.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to understand solution capabilities, data needs, and evaluation approaches; assist in testing and validation activities.
  • Track, analyze, and communicate key success metrics, including productivity gains, operational improvements, and user adoption.
  • Serve as a proactive liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders; help lead workshops, demos, and adoption efforts.
  • Develop clear, executive-ready materials including status updates, presentations, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure adherence to governance, risk, and responsible AI standards; contribute to documentation, approvals, and continuous improvement of AI Hub practices.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in business management or a related discipline.
  • At least 1 year product experience, 1-3 years in financial services.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments including backlog management, sprint planning, user stories, and prioritization frameworks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to decompose complex business problems into actionable requirements.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Intelligent Automation, Data Products, or Digital Employee initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI product lifecycles, model evaluation concepts, workflow orchestration, or automation technologies.
  • Understanding of AI governance, model risk management, privacy, security, or compliance frameworks.

title: Director, Global Real Estate
description:
Grant Thornton is seeking a Director, Global Real Estate to join the team. Approved office locations can be found below.

The Director, Global Real Estate owns the firm's global real estate strategy and portfolio. This is a strategy-and-oversight role for global real estate activities across strategy, workplace design, transactions, and financial management of the global lease portfolio. The Director sets portfolio direction, occupancy strategy, and workplace design standards, and partners closely with Workplace Operations on place-based execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Strategy & Governance

  • Define and own the global real estate strategy, portfolio plan, and occupancy strategy aligned to firm growth and integration

  • Set workplace design standards and guardrails applied across the portfolio

  • Establish real estate governance, data, and analytics to support capital and occupancy decisions

  • Continuously evaluate and propose automation and AI adoption opportunities within real estate and design & construction processes, partnering with Global Transformation & Integration on centralized prioritization and delivery

Transactions & Partner Management

  • Own the transactions strategy and oversee execution through the firm's appointed real estate transactions partner

  • Oversee the external design & construction partner relationships, ensuring best-in-class outcomes with fees appropriately charged to capital projects

  • Manage an outsource provider- and partner-first delivery model, holding partners accountable to performance and service standards

Design & Construction Oversight

  • Own the global design standards, recommending changes in office designs and layouts in accordance with business needs and regional/local adaptions where necessary

  • Ensure projects are delivered on scope, schedule, and budget, and to firm design standards

Data, Analytics & Performance

  • Establish metrics and targets for efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction across the real estate portfolio

  • Build, monitor, and act on reports and dashboards that track performance and progress against targets, elevating the function's data, analytics, and business-intelligence maturity

  • Example metrics: occupancy cost and cost per square foot/seat, lease timelines and upcoming expirations, office/space utilization, portfolio footprint and vacancy/sublease exposure, and capital project budget vs. actual — informing strategic portfolio decisions

  • Use data-driven insights to inform decisions, prioritize improvements, and demonstrate value to firm leadership

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Workplace Operations on place-based execution (occupancy, moves, fit-outs) via the dotted-line relationship with Regional Managers

  • Collaborate with Finance on capital planning, accounting and financial reporting treatment, and project economics

  • Represent the function with strong executive presence, delivering clear, concise, and executive-ready communications and deliverables

  • Co-design the function's detailed target model with the Global Administrative Services Leader

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in real estate, business, architecture/engineering, or a related field (advanced degree a plus)

  • 10+ years of global corporate real estate experience within a multinational organization, including portfolio strategy and transactions oversight

  • Experience leading a partner-led delivery model (brokerage, design, and construction vendors)

  • Strong financial acumen, including capital planning and project economics

  • Proven ability to provide strategic oversight of a global or multi-country portfolio

  • Excellent stakeholder-management and executive-communication skills

  • Ability to travel as business needs arise (international and domestic)

Success Measures

  • A clear, funded global portfolio and occupancy strategy

  • Effective partner performance (transactions and design partners) against cost and service standards

  • Projects delivered on scope, schedule, and budget to design standards

  • Optimized occupancy cost and portfolio footprint over time

  • Metrics, targets, and dashboards established for efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction, with demonstrable progress tracked over time

  • Automation and AI opportunities identified, proposed, and adopted within the function, in coordination with Global Transformation & Integration

The base salary range for this position is between $184,000 and $276,000. Placement within the pay range is at Grant Thornton’s discretion, and it is based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, progression within the role, geographic location, and internal equity. At Grant Thornton, compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Collaboration.Ai is a mission-focused, AI-powered software and services company based in Minnesota, with employees, partners, and customers around the world. We unite people, technology, and purpose to accelerate breakthroughs that transform industries, empower communities, and create a more sustainable future. We collaborate with organizations across the defense ecosystem, helping them navigate complex challenges and drive transformative change.

Our Products

  • NetworkOS — NetworkOS is an AI-powered platform that aligns people, purpose, ideas, and expertise in real-time, generating actionable insights to propel movements forward.
  • CrowdVector — CrowdVector is an integrated solution marketplace and innovation management platform that rapidly uncovers new ideas and advances breakthroughs to fuel movements.

To learn more about us, visit collaboration.ai.

About the Role

You'll ship product across the full NetworkOS stack — Kotlin/Spring Boot microservices through Next.js/React interfaces — keeping the platform reliable, performant, and architected for 10x growth in regulated enterprise and defense environments.

This is a hands-on execution seat on a small, senior team. You'll own complete vertical slices from database schema to UI, with no cross-team handoff gaps and no "not my layer" excuses. Your code commits move the roadmap — and your work is visible from day one.

Whole-stack ownership. Production every week. Code that moves the roadmap.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver features end-to-end — own complete vertical slices (PostgreSQL schema, Kotlin service, GraphQL contract, Next.js UI) and ship production features without waiting on handoffs
  • Own core API and service health — design and maintain GraphQL and REST APIs with clean domain boundaries, keeping latency low and reliability high under growing load
  • Master the data layer — design PostgreSQL schemas, optimize queries for scale, manage zero-downtime migrations with Liquibase, and build effective caching strategies
  • Ship with confidence — comprehensive test suites (unit, integration, contract, UI) at 80%+ coverage, with CI/CD quality gates that catch problems before production
  • Build resilient systems — structured logging, distributed tracing, custom metrics, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation patterns
  • Elevate the team — mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code reviews, architectural discussions, and pair programming
  • Automate with agents — build agentic primitives that make everyday full-stack work faster; AI-native development is how we work, not a side experiment

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Kotlin, Spring Boot, Ktor, Gradle; GraphQL (Netflix DGS); REST/OpenAPI
  • Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript; Turborepo; Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
  • Data Layer: PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Kafka, DynamoDB, Amazon S3
  • AI Integration: Python, FastAPI (LLM-powered service touchpoints)
  • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), Helm, ArgoCD
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Codecov, Snyk
  • Observability: DataDog (APM, logs, tracing), OpenTelemetry
  • Security: AWS KMS, AWS Secrets Manager, Auth0

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, backend-weighted with real production frontend contributions
  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Spring Boot (or Java/Spring with willingness to adopt Kotlin)
  • Working proficiency in TypeScript and React (Next.js preferred) — able to ship UI features within an established design system
  • Solid experience with Python and modern frameworks (FastAPI preferred)
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, relational database design, and migration management
  • Proven track record in continuous delivery environments with automated testing
  • Hands-on Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS; strong grasp of microservices patterns, API design, and distributed systems
  • AI-native workflows — demonstrated ability to leverage Claude Code/Codex or similar agentic coding tools to accelerate development
  • US citizenship required (DoD contracting — IL4/IL5 environments — and FedRAMP compliance)

Nice-to-Haves

  • GraphQL API development and schema design at scale
  • LLM/AI integration patterns (structured outputs, LLM workflow orchestration)
  • Security-conscious development and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, NIST 800-171/800-53)
  • Depth in AWS services (EKS, RDS, S3, Secrets Manager) and DataDog observability
  • Greater Twin Cities, MN based
  • Open-source contributions or active technical community involvement

Why Join Collaboration.Ai?

  • Work that matters. We build AI-powered solutions for defense, healthcare, and regulated industries — SOC 2 and NIST compliance, FedRAMP readiness, and customers whose missions demand the most trustworthy software.
  • AI-native by default. We build with AI, not just for AI. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code/Codex/etc.), agent SDKs and harnesses, MCP servers, and Agent Skills standards are how we work daily. You'll push the boundaries of what AI tooling can do across the full stack.
  • Real ownership. High-autonomy culture on a small, senior team. You'll own outcomes end-to-end — and your work will be seen, used, and valued.
  • Modern stack, no legacy drag. Cloud-native Kubernetes infrastructure, Kotlin and Next.js, continuous delivery — built for growth, not maintenance mode.

title: Assistant General Cousel - Preclinical Research Contracting

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Assistant General Counsel, Preclinical Research Contracting, Office of General Counsel

MSK’s Office of General Counsel is seeking an experienced attorney to join its Preclinical Research Contracting team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to support and advise our scientific and research leaders and aid the MSK Legal team in advancing MSK’s mission of ending cancer for life.

  • Juris Doctor with active bar membership in good standing.

  • Law firm experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of contract law, intellectual property issues, and research transactions.
  • Demonstrated interest in science, research and/or healthcare.

Core Skills:

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication.
  • Excellent issue spotting and negotiating with sharp attention to detail.
  • Exceptional professionalism and client service, including discretion, diplomacy, and sound legal and business judgment.
  • Adeptness at building partnerships and working collaboratively across teams to meet shared objectives.

  • Location: Hybrid with at least two days required onsite at 633 Third Avenue, in NYC (currently Mondays and Tuesdays).

Pay Range: $152,400.00 - $251,600.00

Wir stellen Medikamente und Impfstoffe für die ganze Welt her und unsere Teams betreuen jeden Produktionsprozess.
