Wir entwickeln uns weiterhin, um noch effizienter neue Produkte auf den Markt bringen zu können, während wir gleichzeitig unser gesamtes Portfolio durch unseren ständigen Fokus auf Qualität, Sicherheit und Service liefern. Die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, wird sich ändern. Für viele wird der technologische Wandel und die neuen Produkte revolutionär sein. Unsere R&D-Pipeline erfordert eine neue Art von Lieferkette, und wir brauchen die besten Talente und Fähigkeiten, um uns auf unserer Reise zu unterstützen, komplexere Produkte herzustellen. Dabei setzen wir auf die Vorteile intelligenter Fertigungstechnologien, einschließlich Robotik, digitaler Lösungen und künstlicher Intelligenz, um für die Patienten zu liefern.

Praktikant:in (m/w/d) - QA Sterility Assurance (6 Monate)

Mit einem Praktikum in unserem Bereich QA Sterility Assurance erhältst Du die Möglichkeit, tief in die Welt der Herstellung steriler Produkte einzutauchen und aktiv an spannenden Projekten mitzuwirken. Du übernimmst Verantwortung bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Auswertung einer Feldstudie zur Desinfektionsmittelwirksamkeit, arbeitest dabei eng mit Kolleg:innen aus Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle und Qualitätssicherung zusammen und lernst zentrale Routineaufgaben wie das Monitoring von Reinraumbereichen, Validierungsaktivitäten und GMP-gerechte Dokumentation kennen. Zusätzlich unterstützt Du bei der Planung und Auswertung aseptischer Prozessvalidierungen für sterile Produkte und profitierst von einer engen fachlichen Begleitung durch Expert:innen in einem harmonischen Team, das Dir vielfältige Aufgaben weit über ein Standardpraktikum hinaus bietet.

Während Deines Praktikums erhältst Du Einblicke in folgende Arbeitsbereiche:

  • Im Rahmen der Feldstudie zur Desinfektionsmittelwirksamkeit erarbeitest Du eigenständig Probenahmepläne in Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktionsbereichen, erstellst Validierungsdokumente, betreust die Durchführung und wertest die Ergebnisse aus
  • Zudem koordinierst Du Aufgaben zwischen den Abteilungen und erhältst dadurch Einblicke in Produktions- und Qualitätskontrollbereiche
  • In der Planung der aseptischen Prozessvalidierung erstellst Du eigenständig Prozessvalidierungspläne und Berichte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Produktionsbereichen
  • Darüber hinaus gehört die Durchführung projektartiger Aktivitäten bzw. kleinerer Projekte innerhalb des Bereichs Sterility und Bioburden Control Assurance zu Deinem Aufgabengebiet

Qualifikationen & Fähigkeiten

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Grundstudium der Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaften oder alternativ ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes 2. Staatsexamen in Pharmazie (für Pharmazeut:innen im Praktikum)
  • Ausgeprägte Neugier und Bereitschaft, sich in Themen der Herstellung steriler Produkte – insbesondere Reinigung, Desinfektion und Validierung – einzuarbeiten
  • Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
• Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
• Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
• Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
• Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
• Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:
• Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
• Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
• Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
• Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
• Work in an industrial environment
• Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
• This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
• Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:
• Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
• Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
• Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
• Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
• Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
• Improve effectiveness through process innovation
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

The Lead Coach will update, deliver, and oversee high‑quality training for the George Training Academy. Essential

title: Human Services Assistant III
description:
Title Description- Human Services Assistant III represents the specialist level in the occupational group for Human Services Assistants. Employees serve as the initial point of contact for clients seeking benefits and/ or services and screens clients for benefits and services. Human Services Assistant III is distinguished from Human Services Assistant II by serving as a screener and the initial point of contact for the clients seeking benefits and/or services.
General Work Tasks (Illustrative Only) –
  • Screens clients for benefits and services;
  • Interviews clients and explains programs, services, policies and procedures;
  • Assists clients with applications;
  • Evaluates and approves agency providers;
  • Researches information;
  • Serves as initial point of contact for applicants;
  • Interviews applicants for benefits and/or service programs;
  • Provides information regarding various programs and benefits, general eligibility requirements, policies and procedures;
  • Assists clients with completing applications and performs initial screening of applications;
  • Provides information to clients seeking services and directly makes referrals for services;
  • Researches a variety of databases to obtain and/or verify information needed to process applications;
  • Maintains logs of client documentation received;
  • Schedules and coordinates appointments for clients to meet with benefit, employment or services staff;
  • Contacts clients for requested/needed information and responds to routine questions in person, e-mail or by telephone; and
  • Analyzes needs and coordinates resources that will support families/clients and generates payment for services when appropriate.
  • In addition to the above other illustrative program area assignment/tasks follow:
  • Adult Services/Adult Protective Services:
  • Independently manages the Provider program requirements;
  • Interviews clients and conducts assessment for emergency needs;
  • Manages voucher system and prepares vouchers for ongoing expenditures;
  • Facilitates placement of adults in Adult Living Facilities;
  • Creates and prepares complex statistical reports;
  • Verifies hours and accuracy of time sheets for In-Home Providers;
  • Reviews expenditures and researches operational cost effectiveness; and
  • Prepares, processes, and reconciles budget for various adult programs.
General Work Tasks (continued) –
  • Benefit Programs:
  • Attends and testifies at administrative hearings;
  • Prepares periodic, special and other reports for statistics; and
  • Provides assistance in the orientation/training of new staff.
  • Foster Care:
  • Conducts adoption searches via court records, library, agency files, Internet, City directory, and makes initial contact if a match is found;
  • Assists with subsidy billings and payments;
  • Prepares a variety of financial, statistical forms and reports, case documentation and court reports;
  • Assists in conducting supervised visitation; and
  • Coordinates special event programs such as Toys for Tots, Annual Art Sale, Bags & Bears and unit events.
  • Employment Services:
  • Helps participant in writing resumes; follows up on referrals to ancillary agencies, in person and in writing;
  • Debriefs participants when "fired" from Work Net classes;
  • Locates resources for clients needing appropriate interview clothing and helps clients in making appropriate clothing choices; and
  • Takes participants on educational/career exploration field trips.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Knowledge- Considerable knowledge of: principles and processes for providing customer and personal services (including customer needs assessment, meeting of quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction); structure and content of the English language including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar; and administrative and clerical procedures and systems such as word processing, spreadsheets, managing files and records, and other office procedures and terminology. Working knowledge of: human behavior and performance; individual differences in ability, personality, and interests; learning and motivation; mathematics and research methods; and eligibility requirements for the programs assigned; and available community resources. Some knowledge of laws, regulations, requirements and policies of Local, State, and Federal social, assistance and housing programs.

Skills- Skill in: operating a variety of automated office equipment to include calculator, fax/copier; and the use of computer-driven word processing, spreadsheet, graphics and file maintenance programs.

Abilities- Demonstrated ability to: communicate effectively with program participants; plan, organize, and prioritize own work schedule; establish and maintain working relationships with clients, professionals, co-workers, and the public sufficient to exchange ideas and coordinate activities; accept direction and follow established procedures; counsel others; organize, and post date, from records, reports and other sources using the appropriate format; exhibit solid interpersonal skills, including conflict resolution in working with clients, professionals and employees; create forms, charts, and graphs; add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals; compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs; make screening decisions based upon specific criteria’s; read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, manuals; and conduct effective interviews both face-to-face and by telephone.

Education and Experience- High school diploma supplemented with post-secondary coursework in subjects such as social work, human services, gerontology, or one of the social or behavioral sciences, business or related field, and relevant work experience in public administrative support work OR any equivalent combination of training and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

title: Chef de Rang
description:

Our restaurant will exude charisma and create warmth which you will play a key part in bringing every day.

  • Deliver exceptional, personalized service to guests in the restaurant, bar, and lounge

  • Guide guests through the menu with confidence and knowledge of ingredients and preparation

  • Maintain a deep understanding of food and beverage offerings, including wine pairings

  • Ensure smooth coordination between kitchen and service teams

  • Uphold Four Seasons and Yannick Alléno service standards at all times

  • Anticipate guest needs and respond promptly to requests

  • Contribute to a warm, welcoming, and professional dining atmosphere

  • Support the training and development of junior team members

What you bring:

  • Previous experience in a similar role within a fine dining or luxury hospitality environment

  • A passion for food, wine, and delivering memorable guest experiences

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • A proactive, team-oriented attitude with attention to detail

  • Flexibility to work varied shifts, including weekends and holidays

  • Knowledge of French cuisine or Michelin-starred service is a plus

  • A genuine desire to be part of a dynamic and innovative restaurant team

Just some of the benefits Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane employees enjoy:

  • £42,000 package made of salary and F&B service charge

  • Excellent Training and Career Development opportunities

  • Up to 20 complimentary nights at any Four Seasons Hotels or Resort around the world with years of service.

  • Free meals at Zest while on duty including fruits, coffee/tea and ice cream available throughout the day

  • Holiday entitlement increases with years of service up to 33 days off

  • Free Life Insurance while on duty.

  • Opportunities to build a successful career with global potential

  • Season Ticket Loan & cycle to work scheme

  • Free Uniform dry cleaning available

  • Employee Experience: Annual Themed Employee Party and many social, charitable and sporting events throughout the year.

  • Access to Wagestream – a salary advance benefit

  • Employee Recognition Programmes

  • & many, many more surprises to discover!

Schedule and hours:

This is a full-time position based on a 40-hour work week, typically spread across five 8-hour shifts. Flexibility is essential, as shifts will include mornings, evenings, weekends, and public holidays in line with business needs.

All candidates must possess the right to work in the UK.

We look forward to receiving your application!

description:

The Villeroy & Boch Group with its Ideal Standard brand is one of the world's leading manufacturers in the ceramics and lifestyle sector. title: Workplace Operations - Warsaw
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

A doctorate degree in engineering will substitute for two years of professional engineering experience.

Advanced degrees will substitute for a maximum of two years of professional engineering experience.

There is no substitution for licensed engineering experience.

NOTES:
Engineering experience gained while licensed as a professional engineer will be accepted as licensed engineering experience.

Engineering experience gained after earning an ABET-accredited degree and prior to earning a professional engineer's license (e.g., as an engineer intern applicant, engineer intern, or equivalent) will be accepted as professional level engineering experience.

Applications will be accepted from persons licensed to practice professional engineering in states other than Louisiana. If one of those applicants is selected for the position, he/she will be required to obtain a Louisiana license prior to appointment. The hiring agency will verify that all licensing requirements are met.

Louisiana Professional Engineer licenses are issued by the Louisiana Professional Engineering and Land Surveying Board. Licensing requirements may be viewed at www.lapels.com.

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

title: Quantitative Trading & Research - E-Trading - Associate or Vice President
description:
Job Summary

The Quantitative Trading & Research (QTR) Equity eTrading team designs and delivers quantitative analytics, models, and tools that improve electronic execution outcomes for clients globally. As an Associate/a Vice President in the eTrading team, you will be contributing to the enhancement of our algorithmic execution strategies. You will develop new, advanced quantitative models as well as analysing and improving existing models. You will work closely with Electronic Client Services and trading desks to tailor models, iterate based on experimentation and client feedback, and translate research into measurable performance improvements.

Job Responsibilities

Research and model development

  • Conduct market microstructure research (order books, auctions, venue structure, dark vs. lit dynamics) and quantify the impact on execution outcomes and product design.

  • Analyze large, multi-horizon datasets (tick, intraday, daily) to extract stable causal relationships and signal structures.

  • Evaluate, document, and back‑test methodologies to ensure robustness, reproducibility, and performance under varying market regimes.

  • Lead the development of analytics and data-driven processes to automate and optimize model calibrations.

  • Validate and compare production implementations of models to verify behaviour and outcomes vs research.

Execution measurement and experimentation

  • Design and run empirical studies and controlled experiments (A/B tests) to evaluate routing, scheduling, and parameter changes; define success metrics and ensure robust statistical conclusions.

  • Build tools to analyse execution performance and evaluate experiments.

Data engineering

  • Develop and curate high quality datasets facilitate research into quantitative models for trading algorithms and performance analysis.

Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Technology and Algo Development to industrialize research into production-ready capabilities, including documentation, controls, and model/feature governance.

  • Create client-facing content (methodology papers, execution strategy notes, performance reviews) and support client and internal stakeholder discussions with clear, defensible analytics.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Master’s degree/PhD in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics/Statistics, Physics) or equivalent practical experience.

  • Relevant experience in quantitative research, electronic trading, or related fields.

  • Advanced knowledge of mathematics and statistics (probability theory, time series, econometrics, causal inference).

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or kdb+/q, with experience working with large-scale trading and market datasets.

  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • PhD in a STEM field or a strong independent research track record.

  • Deep knowledge of cash equities market structure and microstructure across major regions.

  • Experience with algorithmic execution strategies.

  • Experience solving stochastic optimization problems.

  • Experience with modern data processing technologies used for research-to-production workflows.

  • Familiarity with machine learning techniques and their application to real world problems.

  • Experience with AWS cloud computing environments and architecture.

title: Service Engineer
description:
As a Service Engineer, you will be responsible for servicing, troubleshooting, testing, commissioning, and supporting NOV's crane and lifting systems. You will work both offshore and onshore, supporting customers in Norway and internationally while helping ensure safe and reliable operation of our equipment.

What We Offer

  • Challenging and varied work in an international company
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development
  • A highly skilled and supportive technical environment
  • Competitive salary and attractive pension and insurance benefits
  • The opportunity to work with market-leading lifting and handling technology
  • International travel and exposure to diverse customer environments
  • A strong safety culture with continuous learning and development

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, inspection, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of NOV crane and lifting systems
  • Act as the primary point of contact between customers and NOV management during offshore assignments
  • Participate in pre-job briefings and post-job debriefings with NOV Supervisors
  • Prepare accurate service reports and contribute to improving procedures, work instructions, and checklists
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and technical support teams to ensure safe and efficient operation of NOV products
  • Follow NOV's Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) standards as well as customer procedures
  • Stay up to date with new products, technologies, and service methods
  • Deliver high-quality customer service while representing NOV professionally

Qualifications & Skills

Essential Qualifications

  • Trade certificate or vocational qualification in Electrical, Automation, Hydraulics, Industrial Mechanics, or another relevant technical discipline
  • Alternatively, relevant technical education or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • Electrical systems
  • Hydraulics
  • Automation and control systems
  • Industrial IT and networking
  • Good communication skills in both Norwegian and English, written and spoken
  • Ability to work independently, systematically, and under pressure
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally
  • Must be based in Norway and able to report to the Service office in Molde

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical college education or higher technical education
  • Experience from offshore, maritime, or industrial service environments
  • Previous experience working with cranes, lifting equipment, or heavy machinery
  • Commissioning or field service experience

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who:

  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to safety and quality
  • Is customer-focused and solution-oriented
  • Enjoys working both independently and as part of a team
  • Is flexible and thrives in a dynamic work environment
  • Has a genuine interest in technology and continuous improvement
  • Builds strong relationships with customers and colleagues

Why Join Us?

Join our global team and help deliver innovative lifting solutions that support the energy industry worldwide. At NOV, you'll work alongside experienced professionals, develop your technical expertise, and contribute to industry-leading products trusted by customers across the globe.

We offer an inspiring workplace with excellent opportunities for career development, continuous learning, and international experience. Together, we solve complex engineering challenges while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence.

title: Service Delivery Lead
description:
BGIS is looking for a Service Delivery Lead to join the team in Remote, US.

BGIS is a leading provider of integrated real estate management services, including facilities management, project management, energy & sustainability services, strategic workplace consulting, real estate services and capital planning. Its range of solutions, supported by efficient systems, processes, and people, enables it to create and optimize places that work for its clients. The team is dedicated to inspiring better business performance and helping clients focus on their core businesses.

Under general direction and guidance from the Regional Manager this role will be responsible for management of the day-to-day Retail Services team operations. The Service Delivery Lead is accountable for day-to-day operations, vendor management and service management for the client(s) they support, as well as, data verification, reporting and analysis; and assists in the review, development and implementation of related processes and initiatives.

  • Good writing and verbal communication skills
  • Good training and presentation skills

  • Ability to perform with minimum direct supervision

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Cloud Composer and Dataform

We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. The team is responsible for Extract, Load, and Transform/Extract, Transform, and Load (ELT/ETL) capabilities used to orchestrate and manage data processing end-to-end, and gain visibility and control over their data, whether the data resides in Google Cloud, on premises, or in other clouds.

Dataform is a new Google Cloud product under BigQuery. Our mission is to provide collaborative code-asset storage and drive billable usage through orchestration and code-powered developer workflows across Data and Analytics.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Design and implement new User Interface elements for Cloud Composer and Dataform and change existing ones to improve User Experience (UX).

title: Solution Architect Telecom & Smart Metering
description:
De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou.

Alliander Telecom levert binnen Aliander alle telecomdiensten die nodig zijn voor de besturing van de energienetten. Een groot domein daarbinnen is de telecom voor de ruim drie miljoen slimme meters van Alliander, deze worden via draadloze telecomtechnieken ontsloten. Telecom bepaalt voor een significant deel de kosten en levensduur van deze slimme meters. Jij helpt ons om hier de juiste technische keuzes voor te maken en deze te realiseren.

Jij bezit technische expertise op het gebied van draadloze telecommunicatie en hebt een interesse die aansluit bij nieuwe business intelligence-diensten. Bij ons werk je aan vraagstukken op het gebied van radiotechnologie en 3GPP-netwerken en -modems, maar ook aan supportsystemen zoals Remote Sim Provisioning (RSP), RADIUS en Monitoring. Security is een belangrijk aandachtspunt, gezien de brede maatschappelijke impact van de slimme meterdienst. De prestaties van de diensten worden bewaakt in een Business Intelligence-omgeving, waar volop ontwikkeling op plaatsvindt.

Wij zijn geen MNO, maar gebruiken diverse netwerken en diensten van derde partijen om een optimale end-to-end-dienst te bouwen voor Alliander. Naast technologische kennis heb je ook de vaardigheden om goed samen te werken met partners en leveranciers, zowel binnen als buiten Alliander.

Zo ben jij onder andere bezig met het:

  • ontwerpen en verbeteren van telecomdiensten en ondersteunende systemen;

  • opstellen van architecturen, migratieplannen en technische roadmaps;

  • begeleiden van aanbestedingen en implementaties;

  • definiëren en toetsen van security-eisen;

  • adviseren bij complexe technische vraagstukken in beheer en operatie;

  • beoordelen van nieuwe technologieën en marktontwikkelingen;

  • samenwerken met leveranciers, partners en collega's binnen Alliander.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander
Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Samen met Liander, Qirion, Qterra, Dep, Firan en Entrnce ontwikkelen én beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners van Nederland. En met de huidige energietransitie is dat hard werken.


Alliander Telecom is de interne telecomprovider die de benodigde telecomdiensten levert op basis van een eigen glasvezelnetwerk en een eigen 450MHz-draadloos netwerk. Goed vooruitkijken kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. De afdeling Telecom bestaat uit ongeveer 70 betrokken specialisten. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat telecom een betrouwbare basis vormt voor de energievoorziening van de toekomst.

Jij maakt het net energieker

Je vindt het leuk om complexe technische vraagstukken terug te brengen tot praktische en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen strategie, architectuur en realisatie en weet verschillende partijen met elkaar te verbinden. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Een wo- of hbo-diploma in een technische richting. Enkele jaren werkervaring in een B2B telecom-omgeving. Onze ervaring is dat een bredere technische achtergrond — bijvoorbeeld vanuit een MKB-bedrijf of een groot intern bedrijfsnetwerk — vaak beter aansluit bij ons werk dan zeer specialistische kennis van één technologie.

  • Technische kennis van en ervaring met draadloze connectiviteit, zoals beschreven in 3GPP/ETSI-, GSMA- en ITU-T-standaarden (denk aan GPRS, LTE, LTE-M, NR, RSP en eUICC). Daarnaast kennis van IP-netwerken en bijbehorende protocollen en systemen (Radius, PKI, NMS/EMS, OSS/BSS) en ervaring met cloudintegraties, API's en een ondersteunend Business Intelligence-landschap.

  • Sterk conceptueel denkvermogen: je zoomt snel in en uit op alle niveaus van een technische keten en hebt ervaring met het maken van ontwerpen en architecturen.

  • Flexibiliteit om uiteenlopend werk op te pakken en je snel nieuwe kennis eigen te maken.

Twijfel je of je aan alle eisen voldoet? Reageer vooral. We kijken graag naar potentieel, motivatie en ontwikkelvermogen.

Voor jou net beter geregeld
Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

  • een salaris van € 5.416 tot € 7.737 bruto per maand in schaal 10.

  • jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.

  • 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, aan te vullen met extra dagen die je vanuit je IKB koopt

  • een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris .

  • het Duurzame Inzetbaarheidsbudget (DIB). Hiervoor krijg je € 700 euro per jaar en die kan je inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld arboproof thuiswerkmeubilair, loopbaanontwikkeling, vakliteratuur, sportabonnement of coaching.

  • de mogelijkheid om zowel op kantoor als thuis te werken als je functie dit toelaat

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over Alliander en al jou arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Voor jou net wat meer informatie

Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton. Binnen 5 werkdagen krijg je een reactie van ons.

Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden vind je meer informatie. Voor deze functie wordt een aanvullende screening uitgevoerd. Heb je nog vragen over de selectieprocedure of screening? Dan helpt Bram van der Linde, Recruiter, jou graag verder via bram.van.der.linde@alliander.com

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Software Engineer, GTM Platform
description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on GTM Platform, you will build the tools, systems, and AI-powered workflows that help Ramp’s go-to-market teams show what is possible for prospective and existing customers. You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering and revenue: creating high-quality demo environments, customer sandboxes, and internal platforms that make it easier for Sales and Solutions teams to move quickly, tell compelling product stories, and unblock complex deals.

Our work directly shapes how the world experiences Ramp before—and as—it becomes a customer. You’ll take ambiguous commercial needs, turn them into thoughtful product experiences, and ship reliable software end to end.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and own software end to end for Ramp’s Sales, Solutions, and customer-facing go-to-market teams—from understanding pain points and defining product requirements to shipping polished, dependable tools.

  • Develop demo and sandbox infrastructure that lets teams showcase Ramp’s capabilities in realistic, compelling, and repeatable ways.

  • Build AI-powered internal workflows and agents that reduce manual work, accelerate deal cycles, and help go-to-market teams solve customer-specific blockers.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Account Management, and core product engineering to turn field feedback into scalable product and platform improvements.

  • Make strong engineering tradeoffs between a one-off enablement need and a reusable platform investment, raising the leverage of every GTM team that uses your work.

What You Need

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience preferred

  • A track record of shipping high-quality products, internal tools, or platform capabilities with real users and measurable impact.

  • Track record of shipping high-quality products at scale

  • Excellent collaboration skills and genuine empathy for internal users, especially customer-facing teams.

  • Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, continuously grow, and master your craft

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

  • One Medical annual membership

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation support to NYC or SF (as needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Leo CT Build
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead customer terminal release program to build, test, and deploy software to millions of customer devices. In this role, you will drive customer terminal software release from planning through execution, including: define the release scope, qualification schedules and dependencies, software deliverables, test coverage auditing, test readiness reviews, test bed support, and venue logistics coordination. You will influence feature delivery schedule, qualification criteria, and test design across multiple teams in the release path, while managing work streams across internal and external teams, proactively addressing risks to the critical path, removing roadblocks through stakeholder coordination and escalation, and tracking actions to closure. You will also be responsible for streamlining the process, and building mechanisms to improve each step in the process.

This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational influence. Your technical domain knowledge, program management fundamentals, and trusted partnerships will enable you to drive organizational alignment and help teams deliver faster with higher quality.

This position requires direct technical experience developing and software release relevant experience. You will create and drive high-level strategic initiatives, streamline the process and build mechanisms to improve process efficiency and transparency.

Key job responsibilities
You will own the end-to-end delivery of cross-functional cross-organizational programs spanning multiple engineering teams and business units. You define program strategy, establish success criteria, and hold yourself and others accountable for outcomes, not just activities.

You will identify risks and blockers early and act immediately to resolve them, escalating with data and proposed solutions rather than waiting for direction. When trade-offs are required, you make the call, communicate the rationale, and move forward.

You will challenge proposals, timelines, and technical approaches when you believe they are wrong, even when it is uncomfortable or unpopular. You bring data, earn trust through your judgment, and once a decision is made, you commit fully and drive execution without hesitation.

You will build mechanisms that create transparency, accelerate decision-making, and prevent recurring failures. You do not accept "that's how we've always done it" as a reason to maintain the status quo.

You will influence L8+ stakeholders and partner teams without formal authority, earning credibility through your depth of understanding, clarity of communication, and track record of delivering results.

You will define and drive operational excellence across your programs, establishing metrics, review cadences, and escalation paths that ensure sustained delivery velocity.

Vacature Restaurant Medewerker (Fulltime/Parttime)

Ben jij klaar voor een baan waarin elke dag een feestje is?

Ben jij op zoek naar een baan of bijbaan waarin geen dag hetzelfde is? Een plek waar je mag stralen, lachen en gasten een onvergetelijke ervaring bezorgt? Dan hebben wij dé uitdaging voor jou!

Kom werken bij Restaurant Vestdijk47 in Pullman Eindhoven Cocagne en beleef samen met een enthousiast team de tijd van je leven.

Waar ga je werken?

Midden in het bruisende hart van Eindhoven vind je Pullman Eindhoven Cocagne, een stijlvol viersterrenhotel waar gastvrijheid centraal staat. Met 320 hotelkamers, 18 multifunctionele zalen voor evenementen en ons sfeervolle restaurant Vestdijk47, is geen dag hetzelfde.

Bij Pullman geloven we dat gastvrijheid uit het hart komt. Daarom noemen wij onze medewerkers niet zomaar collega's, maar Heartists®. Samen creëren we bijzondere momenten voor onze gasten én voor elkaar.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Restaurant Medewerker ben jij het visitekaartje van Bar & Restaurant Vestdijk47. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze gasten zich welkom voelen en een geweldige ervaring beleven, of ze nu komen voor een uitgebreid diner, een gezellige borrel of een exclusief evenement.

Samen maken we het verschil!

  • Je creëert samen met je collega's een warme en gastvrije sfeer waarin iedere gast zich welkom voelt.
  • Je zet graag dat extra stapje om verwachtingen van gasten te overtreffen.
  • Je adviseert gasten over onze gerechten, wijnen en dranken en zorgt voor een persoonlijke beleving.
  • Je verzorgt de dinerservice volgens de kwaliteitsstandaard van Vestdijk47.
  • Je werkt mee aan exclusieve evenementen, zakelijke bijeenkomsten, bruiloften en feestelijke diners binnen Pullman Eindhoven Cocagne.
  • Je draagt actief bij aan een hecht team waarin collega's elkaar helpen, motiveren en samen successen vieren.

  • Je denkt mee over verbeteringen die bijdragen aan een nóg betere gastbeleving.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent iemand die energie krijgt van het blij maken van mensen. Gastvrijheid zit in jouw natuur en je vindt het leuk om onderdeel te zijn van een enthousiast team.

Daarnaast:

  • Ben je een echte teamspeler.
  • Zie je werk liggen en pak je dit zelfstandig op.
  • Houd je van afwisseling, van een intiem diner tot een groot evenement.
  • Ben je representatief, enthousiast en servicegericht.
  • Vind je het vanzelfsprekend om nét dat beetje extra te doen voor iedere gast.
  • Is horeca-ervaring een pré, maar jouw motivatie en gastvrije instelling vinden wij minstens zo belangrijk.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast een gezellige werkplek bieden wij uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Raifah Gremmen: 📧 H5374-HR@accor.com

title: Cobalt TN Repair Technician II
description:
Job Title: Repair Technician

Department: Repair

Reports To: Department Supervisor

FLSA Status: Hourly

Summary: Repair of hulls and/or decks to Cobalt standards while following safety protocols.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities List the job’s essential or most important functions and responsibilities. Include all important aspects for the job whether performed daily weekly, monthly, or annually and any that occur at irregular intervals.

  • Wipe down, buff, and inspect each part to identify flows or damage. Done by manually wiping
  • part off using towel and acetone, buffing the part (removing wax and wiping off compound), visually
  • identifying and marking flaw with grease pencil.

  • Paint over thin or damaged areas of gel coat to create flawless surface.
  • Correct crooked paint lines to create straight paint lines.
  • Repair major areas in hull or deck to correct errors made while cutting.
  • Repairing areas that are damaged during assembly.
  • Inspecting, repairing, and finessing boat at the end of the line
  • Other duties may be assigned.

The role

You own how People Experience actually runs in our core markets: Poland, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Italy, Türkiye, and our Enterprise business unit, TuoTempo. That's 2,200+ DPralians and the local PX Heads who serve them.

Reporting to our Deputy Chief People Officer, Adanya, you will lead the People Experience (PX) Heads (8 direct reports - several of which are leaders, making this a leader of leaders role), partner with our COO, Carlos, and Country Managers, and sit on the PX Leadership team. Your job is to keep international teams focused on what matters most and to make sure it lands — on time, to standard, every quarter. You'll also deep-dive local situations directly on behalf of the dCPO or COO when they need it.

The bar is disciplined, relentless execution.

You will create value by

  • Running the PX operating model in every market. High-quality execution of the core BAU, measured against KPI targets — plus hands-on support to markets that need help hitting them.

  • Owning the business reviews. Country reviews with Country Heads and local PX Heads, and the full Go-to-Market PX review with the dCPO and COO. Clear visibility, honest gap-spotting, and a plan to close each gap.

  • Raising talent density in country leadership teams. Assess bench strength internationally and, with the COO, drive the changes needed through mobility, development or replacement. You take an active role in selecting country leadership team members, advise Country Managers and the COO, and facilitate talent moves — global to local and between locations — where they're the best outcome for Docplanner as a whole.

  • Being the voice of the markets inside global PX. Bring local reality into global projects so solutions are designed for the countries that will run them, and make sure global teams prioritize local demands by criticality.

  • Making local PX teams more efficient. Track productivity against defined standards and convert process, technology and other improvements into real gains.

  • Coaching the local PX leaders. Continuous feedback, support on the hard local calls, and a stronger international PX leadership bench as the result.

What you'll bring

  • An HR Business Partner at heart, from GTM. You've led large markets first-hand, you can hold HR strategy and ground-level HR operations in the same pair of hands, and you don't get distracted by shiny objects or unproven trends.

  • Scale and complexity. Regional or global HR leadership for at least 1,500 people, with HR teams of 50+ including dotted lines.

  • Restlessness in execution and follow-up. You miss no deadlines and you chase until things are closed. You don't bend on commitments — time, quality or actual delivery — and you hold people accountable.

  • Relationships that survive hard conversations. You build trust with business leaders, steer them in the right direction, and occasionally talk sense into them. You lead through influence and expertise, not authority.

  • Cultural range. You navigate a global-and-local organization, converge different ways of working through empathy and common ground, and champion diversity and inclusion in a way that's genuinely relevant locally while staying true to what Docplanner stands for.

  • A data instinct, not a data reflex. You connect business goals to the numbers that actually measure them — and you know when a number isn't the answer.

How success is measured

  • Progress against Go-to-Market PX OITs and KPIs, particularly those tied to the operating model

  • Sales and Customer Success turnover, plus engagement and attrition of high performers

  • New hire retention, and hiring against budget

  • eNPS

  • Speed of underperformance resolution, within the defined timeframe

  • Qualitatively: feedback from business and PX leaders, and the completion, timeliness and accuracy of the global processes driven by other functions and PX teams.

Our process of getting to know each other

  1. Talent Acquisition interview - with Flore

  2. Manager interview - with Adanya

  3. Stakeholder interviews - with Luco and Carlos (in parallel)

  4. Business case - with Adanya, Luco and Carlos

  5. (potential final interview to clarify remaining questions)

Logistics

This role is remote-first, based in one of our European markets (ideally Spain).

Please note we are publishing this opening in multiple locations, but that applying to one opening is enough! :)

title: Animal Care Technician - Part Time
description:
Job Description Summary
Part time, regular (not seasonal) / daytime hours only between 7am - 5pm - targeting average of 24 hours per week (3 days total). Weekend availability required.

The Laboratory Animal Care Technician I is responsible for maintaining the well-being of animals in accordance with all standard operating procedures (SOPs) and applicable state and federal regulations. This position will focus on overall animal care and welfare, facility upkeep, and accurate recordkeeping.

Key Accountabilities

  • Performs routine husbandry (food, water, cleaning pens) for various animal species.
  • Performs general room cleaning procedures, animal husbandry sanitization and water monitoring.
  • Ensures animals have adequate space, safe and secure housing, and appropriate enrichment.
  • Monitors temperature and humidity in animal rooms and reports heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) issues.
  • Completes daily animal welfare/mortality checks and animal husbandry records.
  • Performs pest monitoring for rodents and insects.
  • Provides animal transportation for acquisition and disposal.
  • Monitors inventory levels of related animal care supplies (i.e. feed, enrichment, cleaning supplies, personal protective equipment) including for expiration and notifies supervisor of items that need to be ordered. Assists with stocking supplies.
  • Helps with routine cleaning tasks (i.e., sweep, mop, trash) within the animal vivarium for general facility upkeep and cleanliness.
  • Reviews study protocol and notebook prior to study initiation. Participates in pre-study meetings as necessary.
  • Assists with in-life study conduct procedures and raw data collection, as described in the study protocol and defined by SOPs.
  • Accurately and timely completes appropriate entries into the electronic data capture system or on paper records.
  • Performs animal receiving procedures including preparation of cage cards, entry and study start physical exams, and completion of animal receipt records.
  • Restrains a variety of animal species for treatments/procedures.
  • Provides animal handling for euthanasia procedures.
  • Completes daily data review of paperwork and computer entries to ensure completeness, legibility and accuracy.
  • Learns to perform clinical observations of animals and their pens/cages to assure the well-being, health, and sanitation is adequate.
  • Learns to collect body weights and body score condition.
  • Assists with study acclimation (leash/collar training).
  • Participates in training newly hired employees on proficient procedures.


Other

  • Follows all SOPs and other applicable laboratory or company policies and procedures.
  • Maintains confidential information.
  • Supports and participates in company initiatives as directed.
  • Performs periodic review of all applicable SOPs to ensure accuracy and confirm procedures are being performed according to SOPs.
  • Completes training requirements as assigned and maintains appropriate training documentation.
  • Maintains compliance and adheres to all safety regulations, policies, and procedures and good documentation practices.
  • Develops a working knowledge and ensures compliance with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), Association of Assessment and Accreditation of Laboratory Animal Care (AAALAC), Office of Laboratory Animal Welfare (OLAW), and other applicable regulations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Critical Success Factors

  • Exhibits an aptitude for quality, an eye for detail.
  • Actively supports and contributes to the success of the team. Encourages and practices collaboration and cooperation on the team.
  • Has ability to multi-task and prioritize tasks in a high energy, fast paced environment.
  • Communicates openly and respectfully with team members to foster a positive work environment.
  • Has strong organization skills - establishes and prioritizes tasks to manage time and resources appropriately and identifies resources to meet objectives in a timely manner.
  • Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; manages competing demands; changes approach or method to best fit the situation; able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
  • Has a strong work ethic and positive attitude while working towards or under a given deadline.
  • Is consistently reliable and trustworthy to fulfill commitments, meet deadlines, delivery quality work on time and take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Maintains a commitment to adhere to all safety regulations and procedures.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and understand scientific protocols and reports with a sense for scientific methods.
  • Ability and desire to learn new methods or workflows. Participates in continual training opportunities.


Minimum Requirements

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Previous animal handling/care experience (i.e. dog daycare, pet sitting, domestic pet ownership, etc.)


Preferred Qualifications

  • American Association for Laboratory Animal Science (AALAS) Certification


Working Conditions & Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

(The phrases “occasionally,” “regularly,” and “frequently” correspond to the following definitions: “occasionally” means up to one-third of working time, “regularly” means between one-third and two-thirds of working time, and “frequently” means two-thirds and more of working time.)

  • Ability to regularly lift up to 50 pounds and move heavy equipment in a safe manner.
  • Ability to stand and move (e.g., walk, bend, reach, lift, crouch, push, pull, lift.) throughout an entire work shift.
  • Manual dexterity (e.g., feeling, grasping, fingering, repetitive motion) to operate necessary equipment and perform essential tasks outlined in position description
  • Required to have close visual acuity (e.g., preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading; visual inspection involving small parts) and depth perception (with or without glasses/contacts)
  • Required utilization of provided personal protection equipment (PPE)
  • Occasional exposure to potential hazards such as hot water, steam, mechanical equipment, biological substances, loud noise, odors, chemicals, and to range of outdoor weather conditions
  • Regular on-site attendance as scheduled by management
  • Ability to travel to various site locations

*This position could be offered at different levels for candidates who qualify with a combination of advanced levels of education and/or years of experience. The salary range is $18-$20/hr and will adjust along with the level of the role to match the person’s relevant experience and/or education level.

Salary will be commensurate with experience and responsibilities. This role is not-benefit eligible. Application deadline August 3, 2026. This deadline may be extended if the position is not filled.

title: GTM Intern, Growth Operations
description:
Where multiple locations are listed for this role, the position may be based in any of those locations, with priority determined according to the order of listing.

Leads are arriving faster than we can route them, and the systems that should catch them are still being built. This role is for someone who sees a messy funnel and wants to fix the plumbing.

You'll own the operational layer underneath our go-to-market motion: how leads get captured, scored, routed, and measured. It's not glamorous work, but done well it's the difference between a pipeline that compounds and one that leaks.

What you'll do

  • Own inbound lead flow: capture, deduplicate, enrich, and route leads so nothing falls through

  • Build and maintain lead scoring and segmentation rules, then refine them as we learn what converts

  • Keep our CRM and GTM tooling clean and trustworthy, since every downstream decision depends on it

  • Build the funnel reporting the team actually reads: weekly conversion, stage drop-off, and channel efficiency

  • Automate repetitive GTM work using no-code tools and light scripting

  • Instrument outbound sequences and campaigns so results can be measured and compared

  • Turn one-off manual tasks into reusable systems that keep working after you've moved on

You might be a fit if

  • You're pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • You've worked with CRM, automation, or analytics tooling, whether HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Airtable, or similar

  • You're comfortable with spreadsheets at a serious level, and you know some SQL or Python or want to learn

  • You think in systems: you'd rather build the process once than do the task ten times

  • You're data-informed and understand the basics of funnels and attribution

  • You're detail-oriented, because bad data quietly breaks everything downstream

Bonus: experience building dashboards, or prior ops work at a startup

A Day in the Life

Soulager la douleur, rétablir la santé et prolonger la vie, c’est guidé par cette mission que Medtronic continue de faire bénéficier ses thérapies innovantes à des millions de patients. Aujourd’hui, l’opportunité vous est donnée d’intégrer la plus grande entreprise de Dispositifs Médicaux au monde et de participer à ce challenge quotidien. En tant qu’Attaché(e) de Recherche Clinique, vous serez responsable du suivi de la recherche clinique menée dans les centres d’investigation afin d’assurer la conformité aux protocoles d’étude, au normes réglementaires applicables, aux politiques du comité de protection des personnes ainsi qu’aux procédures de Medtronic.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion des études au sein de Medtronic ainsi qu’avec le personnel sur centre pour la résolution des problèmes et le bon déroulement des études cliniques.

Vous serez idéalement basé sur le secteur Ile-de-France. Le poste implique également une couverture France, Belgique et Suisse, des déplacements sont à prévoir en conséquence (approx. 20% du temps).

Ce poste est ouvert en CDD 12 mois.

Les responsabilités peuvent inclure les activités suivantes et d'autres activités peuvent être assignées

  • Participation à la sélection des centres et recommandation d’investigateurs qualifiés.

Connaissances et expériences requises

  • Français et Anglais courants, à l’oral et à l’écrit ;
  • Bon relationnel, à l’aise avec le travail en équipe ;
  • Capacité à identifier les priorités et à gérer les impératifs de délais sur plusieurs projets en parallèle ;
  • Agilité avec les outils informatiques, applications et Microsoft Office ;
  • Un à quatre ans d’expérience en recherche clinique ;
  • Connaissance des réglementations et normes applicables (BPC, ISO, directive Européenne, etc.) ;
  • Expérience ou connaissance de l’industrie de la santé, connaissance de la terminologie médicale ;
  • Aptitude à la résolution de problèmes.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

title: CyberProgram Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Cyber Security Program Analyst to join a global cybersecurity transformation initiative focused on strengthening cyber resilience, IT risk management, and operational resilience across multiple international entities.

This role sits within a Group Cyber Security Program team responsible for driving cybersecurity maturity, harmonizing security practices, and ensuring compliance with internal frameworks and regulatory requirements. You will work in a highly collaborative and international environment, interacting with cybersecurity experts, risk professionals, and stakeholders across different business entities.

The position offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of cybersecurity domains, contribute to strategic initiatives, and play an active role in improving the organization's overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the deployment and execution of cybersecurity maturity assessments across assigned entities.
  • Guide stakeholders in understanding cybersecurity requirements and gathering the necessary evidence for compliance reviews.
  • Review and assess submitted evidence, ensuring consistency and alignment with established evaluation standards.
  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding framework updates, changes, and remediation expectations.
  • Act as a liaison between centralized IT providers and local entities to facilitate cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Document assessment results and contribute to governance reporting and management dashboards.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of assessment methodologies, processes, and tooling.
  • Support strategic initiatives designed to enhance cybersecurity maturity and operational resilience across the organization.

Why Join This Team?

  • Be part of a large-scale cybersecurity transformation program with strategic visibility.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity specialists and stakeholders across multiple countries and business areas.
  • Develop expertise across a wide range of cybersecurity, IT risk, and resilience domains.
  • Gain valuable exposure that can support future career growth toward roles such as Cyber Security Manager, CISO, IT Risk Manager, Program Manager, or Cyber Security Specialist.

Required

  • General knowledge of Cyber Security, IT Risk Management, and Information Security principles.
  • Understanding of IT processes, security controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with risk management concepts and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

Preferred

Knowledge or experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • IT Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Backup Management, including regulatory requirements such as DORA.
  • Cryptography, including key management, certificate management, and cryptographic governance.
  • Network Security, including network segmentation, hardening, and secure architecture principles.
  • Security frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or equivalent.

title: Associate Director, Physical Security
description:
Grant Thornton is seeking an Associate Director, Physical Security to join the team. Approved office locations can be found below.

Role Summary

The Associate Director, Physical Security leads the firm's dedicated physical security function owning physical security standards and programs across the firm's offices — access control, badging, surveillance, workplace safety, crisis management and emergency preparedness, travel risk support, and incident response for physical locations. The Associate Director sets global standards, provides security design input for new and changing offices, leads a small hands-on physical security team, and partners with Workplace Operations and Regional Managers for local execution.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Standards

  • Define global physical-security standards, policies, and programs across all offices

  • Establish a risk-based approach to site security, prioritizing by location profile and threat level

  • Establish crisis management and emergency/business continuity preparedness expectations, including emergency protocols, crisis coordination, and physical incident response procedures for evacuation, shelter-in-place, and active-threat scenarios

  • Partner with Information Security to ensure clear lanes and coordinated response where physical and cyber risks intersect

  • Define physical security design standards and provide input for new offices, builds, renovations, and security technology deployments

  • Continuously evaluate and propose automation and AI adoption opportunities within physical-security operations, partnering with Global Transformation & Integration on centralized prioritization and delivery

Security Operations

  • Own access control, badging, visitor management, and surveillance (CCTV) standards and systems

  • Lead physical-security incident response, investigations, and escalation management for firm locations

  • Monitor workplace violence risk, lead threat assessments, and coordinate appropriate prevention, escalation, and response actions with firm stakeholders
  • Coordinate workplace safety, travel risk assessments, and executive support for the Executive Committee (EC) where appropriate

Data, Analytics & Performance

  • Establish metrics and targets for efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction across physical-security operations

  • Build, monitor, and act on reports and dashboards that track performance and progress against targets, elevating the function's data, analytics, and business-intelligence maturity

  • Example metrics: security incident volume and severity, incident response and resolution times, access-control compliance rates, site risk assessments completed, and guarding/technology provider performance

  • Use data-driven insights to inform decisions, prioritize improvements, and demonstrate value to firm leadership

Provider & Regional Delivery

  • Manage guarding and security-technology providers, including performance and service delivery

  • Deliver execution regionally in partnership with Workplace Operations and Regional Managers

  • Lead a small physical security team with a hands-on operating style, staying actively involved in day-to-day priorities, escalations, and execution

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Build awareness and training programs to strengthen a security-conscious culture

  • Advise firm leadership on physical-security risk and mitigation

  • Represent the function with strong executive presence, delivering clear, concise, and executive-ready communications and deliverables

  • Co-design the function's detailed target model with the Global Administrative Services Leader

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in security management, criminal justice, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 10+ years of corporate physical-security experience, including program leadership

  • Experience with access-control, surveillance, incident-response, emergency preparedness, threat-assessment, and travel-risk processes

  • Relevant certification (e.g., CPP) a plus

  • Strong provider-management, stakeholder-management, and communication skills

  • Ability to operate across a multi-site, multi-country footprint

Success Measures

  • Consistent physical-security standards implemented across offices

  • Effective incident prevention, response, and resolution

  • Crisis management, emergency preparedness, workplace violence monitoring, and threat-assessment processes established and regularly exercised

  • Strong provider performance and service quality

  • Improved security awareness and reduced site risk over time

  • Metrics, targets, and dashboards established for efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction, with demonstrable progress tracked over time

  • Automation and AI opportunities identified, proposed, and adopted within the function, in coordination with Global Transformation & Integration

The base salary range for this position is between $152,000 and $228,000. Placement within the pay range is at Grant Thornton’s discretion, and it is based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, job -related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, progression within the role, geographic location, and internal equity. At Grant Thornton, compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

title: UTIA Sub-Award Coordinator - Office of Sponsored Programs
description:
The UT Institute of Agriculture is seeking an Associate Subaward Coordinator to support the administration of sponsored projects that advance research, Extension, teaching, and service across Tennessee and beyond. This position plays an important role in helping faculty and staff manage subaward agreements accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with sponsor, federal, state, and university requirements.

This is a strong opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys research administration, problem-solving, customer service, and working with a wide range of internal and external partners. The successful candidate will coordinate subaward agreements, support subrecipient monitoring, maintain accurate records, and provide guidance to principal investigators, departmental staff, and partner organizations.

The Associate Subaward Coordinator will coordinate the subaward process from request through execution, monitoring, modification, and closeout. Core responsibilities include:

  • Coordinate the preparation, review, routing, issuance, modification, and closeout of incoming and outgoing subaward agreements.
  • Review subaward requests for completeness, accuracy, allowability, and compliance with sponsor requirements and university policies.
  • Collect required documentation and supporting materials for subaward actions.
  • Track subaward status and move agreements and modifications through the process in a timely manner.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records in university research administration systems.
  • Submit Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act reports through SAM.gov as required.
  • Review subrecipient compliance documentation, certifications, audit reports, and required assurances.
  • Conduct and document subrecipient risk assessments in accordance with applicable federal regulations and university requirements.
  • Identify and escalate compliance concerns and help coordinate appropriate follow-up with university offices.
  • Communicate with principal investigators, departmental business staff, Sponsored Projects Accounting, central research administration offices, external subrecipient organizations, and sponsoring agencies.
  • Provide guidance on subaward requirements, documentation, and administrative processes.
  • Serve as a resource for complex or escalated subaward and agreement questions.
  • Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing for team members and administrative staff.
  • Assist with process improvement efforts, reports, procedural guides, training materials, and other sponsored projects initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional who can manage detailed administrative and compliance work while providing clear, responsive service to campus and external partners. The ideal candidate will be able to organize work, meet deadlines, interpret requirements, and communicate effectively with individuals who have varying levels of experience with sponsored projects administration.

Successful candidates will bring:

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when working with sensitive information.
  • Ability to interpret and apply policies, procedures, regulations, and agreement terms.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with faculty, staff, central offices, and external partners.
  • Interest in continuous improvement, training, and practical problem-solving.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and enterprise business systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may substitute for the degree where permitted.
  • Three years of progressively responsible experience in sponsored projects administration, grants administration, research administration, contracts administration, compliance, finance, higher education administration, or a closely related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree.
  • Five years of progressively responsible experience in sponsored projects administration, grants administration, research administration, contracts and subawards administration, compliance, finance, higher education administration, or a closely related field.
  • Experience with subawards, subrecipient monitoring, risk assessment, or sponsored research agreements.
  • Knowledge of Uniform Guidance, federal sponsor requirements, and university research administration processes.
  • Experience with federal sponsors such as USDA, NIH, NSF, DOE, or similar agencies.
  • Experience using research administration or financial systems such as Cayuse, Huron, DASH, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support operational efficiencies.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume workload in a complex research or higher education environment.

Work Location and Schedule

This position is located in Knoxville, Tennessee. The work arrangement may be onsite, hybrid, or remote as approved by the hiring department and based on business needs. Any approved remote or hybrid arrangement will include expectations for availability, communication, service delivery, and any required onsite presence.

Compensation and Benefits

UT market range: MR 11

Anticipated hiring range: $66,000 - $75,000
