title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Willis Re is expanding it’s Global business in 2026 and the Cloud and Infrastructure team will need to support this growth by designing, provisioning then supporting the platforms to enable this.

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Cloud & Infrastructure team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, operating, automating, and continuously improving enterprise-scale Azure platforms, ensuring high availability, resiliency, security, and performance.

The role combines software engineering, cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, and operational excellence to improve service reliability and reduce operational overhead through automation and engineering best practices.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Microsoft Azure, DevOps, Terraform, API, disaster recovery planning, and enterprise-scale resilience engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Reliability & Operations

  • Ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and reliability of Azure-hosted services.
  • Define and manage Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets.
  • Proactively monitor platform health and performance using observability tooling.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring incidents.
  • Participate in incident management and on-call support rotations where required.
  • Lead blameless post-incident reviews, capture lessons learned, and drive corrective actions through to completion.
  • Reduce operational toil by identifying repetitive manual tasks and replacing them with automated, reusable engineering solutions.
  • Develop reliability dashboards and actionable alerts that focus on customer-impacting symptoms rather than infrastructure noise.

Azure Cloud Engineering

  • Design, deploy, and manage Azure infrastructure services including:
    • Virtual Networks
    • Application Gateways
    • API Management
    • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
    • Azure Firewall
    • Azure Storage
    • Key Vault
    • Azure Monitor
    • Azure AI Services
  • Implement cloud platform standards and best practices.
  • Support multi-region Azure deployments and platform modernisation initiatives.
  • Undertake capacity planning and performance engineering to ensure platforms can scale reliably in line with business growth and peak demand.

Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules and reusable infrastructure patterns.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards and governance controls.
  • Ensure infrastructure is version controlled, peer-reviewed, and fully automated.
  • Manage Terraform state securely and consistently across environments.

Azure DevOps & Automation

  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments.
  • Implement testing, security scanning, policy compliance, and release gates.
  • Support GitOps and platform engineering practices.
  • Create automation for operational runbooks, self-healing processes, deployment validation, and environment consistency checks.

Resilience, Disaster Recovery & Failover

  • Design and implement highly available Azure architectures.
  • Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities.
  • Implement and test:
    • Regional failover strategies
    • Active/Passive architectures
    • Active/Active deployments
    • Traffic Manager and Front Door failover patterns
    • Database resiliency and replication
    • Backup and recovery solutions
  • Conduct regular resilience and recovery testing exercises.
  • Identify and reduce single points of failure across platforms.
  • Define and execute game days, chaos testing, and controlled failure scenarios to validate operational resilience.

Security & Governance

  • Ensure platforms are secure-by-design.
  • Work closely with Security and Architecture teams to implement:
    • Zero Trust principles
    • RBAC controls / Managed Identities
    • Network segmentation
    • Secrets management
  • Support compliance requirements and operational audits.
  • Help coordinate security updates, patches, maintenance routines, and upgrades of the underlying system across partners and vendors
  • Embed reliability, security, and compliance controls into build and release pipelines to support production readiness.

Continuous Improvement

  • Drive automation and reduction of manual operational tasks.
  • Improve deployment reliability and platform observability.
  • Contribute to architecture standards, runbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture, security, and service teams to define production readiness standards and reliability acceptance criteria.

About You

At Willis Re we work in a fast paces evolving environment with a growth mindset and outcome focus.

Core Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in senior positions
  • Ability to articulate complex ideas and scenarios into business language
  • Ability to manage and prioritise workload
  • Worked in a fast paced complex environment and demonstrate hands on experience
  • Microsoft Azure Expert
    • Azure Administration and Architecture
    • Networking and Connectivity
    • Virtual Machines and Platform Services
    • Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
    • Azure Identity and Access Management

title: Customer Value Partner
description:
About Us

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world.

Your Mission

As a Customer Value Partner at Hawk, you own the customer relationship from first

scoping through implementation and into ongoing growth: one name, one

accountable owner, no handoffs between a CSM, an Engagement Manager, and a PM

along the way. You run delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology,

and you're judged on whether the customer hits the outcomes we promised. At the

core of the role is understanding what value actually means for each customer, in

their own numbers, against their own objectives, and then building it, not reporting

on it after the fact. You're not a project manager who bends to every customer's

internal governance model. You're the person who proves the value Hawk delivers,

then converts that proof into retained and expanded revenue.

Key Responsibilities

 Own the full customer lifecycle for your portfolio, from initial scoping and

implementation through to ongoing value realization, adoption, and new use

cases. There's no relay handoff here; you carry the account start to finish.

 Manage delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology: build

the plan, track progress against it, and report clearly. Lightweight project

management, owned by us.

 Understand what value truly means for each customer, in their own numbers,

and then build it. Design and drive joint success plans that align Hawk's

delivery to each client's real business objectives and regulatory context, not a

generic template.

 Own commercial outcomes: drive GRR and NRR for your accounts, and where

contract terms carry revenue contingency, own that recognition outcome too.

You're not negotiating deal terms, but you're building and proving the

confidence that gets deals signed and renewed.

 Monitor usage and performance relentlessly, and turn what you find into

optimization work: false positives down, analyst hours back, faster

investigations. These are numbers customers see in their own systems, not

numbers we tell them about.

 Bring AI and agentic AI tools and techniques into how you manage your

customers: faster QBR prep, sharper account insight, more consistent reporting,

so your time goes to judgement and relationships, not manual admin.

 Work the sales cycle as a credibility engine, not a seller. You get pulled into pre-

sale conversations to build confidence that Hawk can actually deliver what's

being promised, backed by your own track record of having done it, and you're

the SME customers turn to for end-to-end value creation and enablement with

Hawk's technology.

 Build and defend executive relationships across the account, from governance

calls to QBRs, so that Hawk's value is something the customer's leadership sees

and states in their own words, not something we have to convince them of

every quarter.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years in customer-facing roles spanning some combination of customer success, engagement management, or delivery/project management within B2B enterprise software. This role consolidates all three, so breadth across them matters more than a title match.

  • A real track record managing accounts at $500K+ ARR, including cross-sell or expansion work you can point to and explain, not just accounts you kept alive.

  • Comfortable owning a delivery plan end to end, scoping, tracking, and reporting, using Hawk's best practices and methodology, without needing a separate PM in the room to keep things on track.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS and enterprise software delivery models; experience in AML, fraud prevention, or another regulated financial services domain is a real advantage, not a nice-to-have footnote.

  • Hands-on comfort with AI and agentic AI tools and techniques, and you actually use them, to work faster, sharpen your analysis, and raise the quality of what you deliver to customers, not just aware that they exist.

  • Genuine comfort operating at C-suite level. You can run a governance call with a customer's leadership team and hold your own, translating delivery status into a conversation executives actually want to have.

  • A bias toward ownership over process. You understand what value actually means for a customer, not just what the contract says, and you close the gap yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Experience in, or real appetite for, a start-up or scale-up environment where the account model is still being built as you go, not a fully mature playbook you're just executing.

Bonus

  • Fluent in German or another language relevant to Hawk's EMEA customer base, in addition to fluent English.

  • Prior experience where you personally carried both the commercial number (GRR/NRR) and the delivery outcome for the same account, rather than one or

    the other

title: Medical Laboratory Technician – Student Health Center - UTK
description:
The University of Tennessee Student Health Center is currently seeking a Medical Laboratory Technician. The Medical Laboratory Technician evaluates, interprets, and makes judgement calls regarding laboratory testing. This position performs testing procedures in all areas of a physician’s office laboratory including hematology, chemistry, microbiology, urinalysis, parasitology, electrocardiograms, and other special procedures. This position is to follow all laboratories, and clinical policies and procedures related to testing regarding specimen collection, quality control, result verifications, reporting, infection control, lab safety, working with a bi-directional lab information system, and is accountable to the lab supervisor.

The Medical Laboratory Technician provides comprehensive lab testing duties based on CLIA standards, and medical policies and procedures.

Performance of Laboratory Startup Procedures including:

  1. Prior to any patient testing and the Medical Laboratory Technician performs a pretesting maintenance procedure on all instruments, machinery, and laboratory reagents to ensure reliability. Troubleshoots issues if discrepancies are found.
  2. Records all temperatures daily for the CO2 incubator, two refrigerators, laboratory freezer, and the room temperature of the laboratory.
  3. Examines and interprets bacterial cultures from the previous day and any suspicious colony is to be inoculated and re-read the following day for confirmation of suspected result.
  4. Reviews all reference laboratory results from the previous day, documents results, and distributes to the nursing staff.

Direct Laboratory Duties:

  1. Performs venipuncture using aseptic technique. Follows universal precautions, and laboratory safety procedures.
  2. Performs electrocardiograms and spirometry testing as ordered.
  3. Performs daily quality controls for all tests which are assayed.
  4. Examines and interprets lab specimens including those for hematology, chemistry, microbiology, urinalysis, parasitology, electrocardiograms, and other special procedures.
  5. Documents all results in the appropriate lab log and distributes copies of lab results to nursing staff. Immediately contacts the attending medical provider when critical laboratory results are received.
  6. Collects and prepares specimens to be sent to the outside reference laboratory for processing. Confirms all patient identifying information is accurate prior to sending specimens to reference laboratory.

Indirect Laboratory Duties:

  1. Performs and passes proficiency testing from an outside laboratory testing entity to ensure competency.
  2. Performs and passes annual OSHA training, FERPA/HIPAA and Title IX training.
  3. Must maintain CPR certification.
  4. Must complete 24 hours of continuing medical education bi-annually to maintain licensure.
  5. Orders inventory supplies and ensure supplies have not expired.
  6. Assists in the preparation for accreditation, state laboratory inspections, and Clinical Laboratory Improvement surveys (CLIA).
  7. Reports to the Lab Supervisor and perform duties requested by supervisor.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Associate’s degree from an accredited college approved Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT) program.
  • Licensure: Must be licensed as a Medical Laboratory Technician by the State of Tennessee’s Medical Board.
  • Experience: Must have two years of experience in a related laboratory setting.
  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: Must have the skill to perform venipuncture. Must have the knowledge, skills and abilities to interpret and analyze laboratory specimens. Must have the knowledge to troubleshoot laboratory results and data into the electronic health record. Must have the ability to multi-task and perform many laboratory functions simultaneously. Must obtain and maintain CPR certification on annual basis. Must complete 24 hours of continuing medical education bi-annually to maintain Tennessee licensure.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without need now or in the future for sponsorship for employment-based visa status.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience: Previous experience working in a University Student Health Center and/or utilized Medicat as the electronic health record system. Previous experience working with the ORCHARD lab information system and on a bi-directional feed basis.
  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: Knowledge, skills and abilities to setup a lab information system within a health record practice management system.

Work Location

  • 100% Onsite, 1800 Volunteer Blvd, Knoxville, TN 37996

Compensation and Benefits

  • UT market range: Market Range 07
  • Anticipated hiring range: Commensurate with education, experience, and licensure.
  • Find more information on the UT Market Range structure here
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

For best consideration applicants should submit the below materials:

  • Cover letter
  • Resume
  • Three professional references
  • Copy of Medical license issued by the State of Tennessee

About The College/Department/Division

The Division of Student Life is comprised of an outstanding group of professionals who create student-centered opportunities that contribute to a transformative Volunteer Experience. These opportunities allow students to grow their skills and knowledge outside of the classroom. From health and wellness to service and engagement, we provide opportunities where students exemplify the Volunteer Spirit, inspiring others to learn, lead, and serve.

description:

Founded to shape the future of pensions, health, and insurance solutions, Aptia is a leading professional services firm dedicated to simplifying complexity for businesses and individuals. Specialist. Responsive. Thoughtful. Our values aren't just words; they are the backbone of our business. Our team embodies our values daily, to surpass client expectations, evolve constantly and nurture genuine relationships for the long-term.

Job requirements

Aptia are seeking a Head of Risk & Compliance (SMF16/17) to support with the build out and ongoing governance leadership of our new consulting entity.


As our UK Consulting business (Aptia Pension Consulting) continues to evolve and expand its regulated service offering, you will play a pivotal role in establishing the governance, risk and compliance framework that will support the next phase of growth. You'll lead the development of our regulatory infrastructure, help drive FCA authorisation activity, and create a robust, scalable control environment fit for a modern consulting organisation.


If you're energised by creating new frameworks, influencing strategy, and operating at executive level, this role offers a unique platform to make a lasting impact.


This is a visible senior role with responsibility for shaping and embedding the governance, compliance and risk agenda across our UK Consulting business.

This is a hybrid role which can align with any Aptia UK office, though travel to the London Head Office will be required.


Key responsibilities:


• Lead the design and implementation of a governance and risk framework for a newly established regulated consulting business.
• Act as the senior compliance leader and, following authorisation, perform the FCA-approved SMF16 and SMF17 responsibilities.
• Build and oversee compliance monitoring, risk management and assurance activities.
• Establish policies, committees, reporting structures and controls that support long-term growth and regulatory excellence.
• Own the financial crime framework, including AML, sanctions, fraud prevention and regulatory reporting obligations.
• Lead regulatory engagement and act as a key point of contact with the FCA.
• Oversee data privacy governance and ensure compliance with UK GDPR and associated regulatory requirements.
• Provide expert guidance and constructive challenge to senior leaders, governance committees and boards.
• Help shape a culture of accountability, customer focus and strong risk management across the business.

We are interested in experienced compliance and risk leaders who combine strong technical expertise with a builder's mindset.

Here’s what we’re looking for:


• Significant experience within FCA-regulated financial services environments, ideally in build or growth environments.
• Previous experience operating as an SMF16, SMF17, MLRO or equivalent senior compliance leader.
• A proven track record of engaging directly with regulators and leading regulatory interactions.
• Experience developing and embedding governance, compliance and risk frameworks.
• Deep knowledge of FCA regulations, SMCR, conduct risk and financial crime requirements.
• Strong leadership, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
• The ability to thrive in a growing, evolving environment where you can balance strategy with hands-on execution.

You will ideally come from a financial services background, and experience working within a PE backed business environment would be advantageous.


This is an opportunity to take ownership, shape a new practice, and help create a governance framework that supports sustainable growth for years to come.

How to apply

If you are interested in this role, then we’d love to hear from you. Please go ahead and click apply and submit your resume with appropriate contact information.

title: IT Security Specialist
description:
What is the job?

Montu UK is entering an exciting new phase in its security journey: creating an independent, future-ready architecture for the UK and Europe. We’re moving beyond shared APAC infrastructure to establish our own tenants, controls and security ecosystem -built specifically for the unique demands of our rapidly growing UK and EU operations.

Australia has already developed a mature security architecture; this role is an opportunity to take that strong foundation and shape it for an entirely different regulatory and operational landscape. You’ll build security around requirements including CQC, GPhC, MHRA, Home Office controlled drugs, UK GDPR and NHS DSPT, while supporting an expanding estate that includes our Winnersh Triangle site, EU tenant separation and continued European growth.

This is not a governance-only role focused on auditing, reporting or writing policies - we already have dedicated teams owning that work. We need a hands-on security builder: someone who can design, implement and operate meaningful controls, solve complex technical challenges and strengthen our security capabilities from the inside.

You’ll work directly alongside the IT Manager as a close collaborator on both strategy and delivery, with the Support Analyst and HiLabs Ireland contact forming your wider working circle. You’ll be part of the team building and delivering the architecture -not standing outside it and checking the work.

Given the regulatory responsibility Montu carries, sound judgement and trustworthiness are essential - but so is momentum. We value practical progress over perfection: someone who can implement a strong, effective control today, learn from it and continue improving it, rather than spend months developing a flawless policy that never makes it into practice.

What will you be doing?

This is a delivery role. Representative work already in flight or on the near-term roadmap:

  • Endpoint & identity security engineering - contributing to the CrowdStrike AU→UK CID migration (Intune-deployed, scripted), Entra ID configuration for the new EU/UK tenant, and Intune/MDM policy build-out.

  • Network security delivery - hands-on work on Netskope deployment for SaaS/web steering, Tailscale ACL and zero-trust access design, and FortiGate/UniFi security configuration for the Winnersh Triangle site.

  • Site security build - working the physical/technical security side of the Winnersh Triangle stand-up: access control (Paxton), CCTV, structured cabling security, vendor delivery oversight (we're mid-RFP with Safeguard Systems and FTL Secure Solutions) - this is real vendor and project management, not paperwork.

  • Compliance-as-engineering - turning ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials Plus requirements into actual implemented controls rather than just gap-analysis documents; supporting DSPT evidence with real technical artefacts.

  • Incident response & monitoring - building out our detection and response capability as it matures, being a genuine first responder rather than a policy author.

  • Vendor & pentest liaison - working with our security partners (e.g. Klaatu IT Security) on delivery, not just contract admin - reviewing findings and personally driving remediation.

  • Documentation that's useful, not performative - technical runbooks, architecture diagrams, and control evidence that the team actually uses, versus policy for policy's sake.

You'll be a second pair of hands and a second brain on all of this - someone the IT Manager can hand a problem to and trust it gets solved, not just assessed.

What do you need?

The mindset matters more than the checklist:

  • You'd rather fix the thing than write a memo about the thing.

  • You see security as an enabler of the business (clinicians, pharmacy, patients) rather than a department of "no."

  • You're comfortable being hands-on in Intune, a firewall config, or a script at 4pm and in a vendor negotiation or compliance conversation at 10am.

  • You work well in a very small, very autonomous team - this is not an environment with layers of process to hide behind; you'll need to be self-directed.

  • You’ll need to “muck-in” with the team if the need arises for any & all technology issues.

Technical experience (ideally several of the following):

  • Endpoint protection platforms (CrowdStrike, Sophos, or similar EDR/XDR)

  • Microsoft Entra ID / Intune, and modern zero-trust access tooling (Tailscale, Netskope, Cloudflare Zero Trust, or similar)

  • Network security fundamentals (FortiGate or similar UTM/firewall, VLAN segmentation, secure site network design)

  • ISO 27001 and/or Cyber Essentials Plus - from an implementation angle, not just an audit angle

  • Working knowledge of UK GDPR and healthcare-adjacent regulatory environments (CQC, NHS DSPT, GPhC, MHRA) - or a fast learner who can pick this up with support

  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar) for security tooling and deployment

  • Comfort working with regulated, patient-data-adjacent systems

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in a healthcare, pharmacy, or life sciences environment

  • Experience helping a business separate from a parent company's IT estate (tenant migrations, identity separation)

  • CREST, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent - valued but not gatekept on; we care more about what you've built than the letters after your name

What this role is not:

  • Not a compliance-only or audit-only function

  • Not a "security says no" gatekeeper role

  • Not a large-team, heavily hierarchical environment - this is scrappy, fast-moving, and hands-on

  • Not someone who hands work back to the IT Manager to implement - you implement it

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Vice President - Product Owner Managed Solutions
description:
Own a high-visibility enterprise platform agenda that improves quality, resilience, and speed to market for clients. Shape modernization across automated regression testing, AI-ready foundations, and end-to-end observability. Influence senior stakeholders by translating complex engineering needs into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes.


As a Vice President, Product Owner within the Managed Solutions Product team, you define and execute the vision for enterprise platform modernization across automated regression testing, AI-ready capabilities, and full observability. You drive the end-to-end product lifecycle from strategy and roadmap to delivery, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
You orchestrate cross-functional execution across business, technology, data, QA, risk, operations, and SRE to improve platform quality and performance.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Be the platform SME for investment exposure analytics and define the product vision, roadmap, and delivery agenda for scalable enterprise capabilities, including modernization of core platform services, common data foundations, reusable APIs, and resilient operating models.

  • Define and socialize a clear AI-ready platform vision aligned with business priorities, data governance, model consumption needs, and responsible AI standards.

  • Own the observability product agenda across logs, metrics, traces, service health, alerting, dashboards, incident insights, and operational reporting, ensuring platform telemetry supports reliability, availability, performance, and executive decision-making.

  • Own the product backlog, prioritize features based on value, risk, and feasibility; run sprint planning and quarterly planning. Review completed work to ensure it meets the acceptance criteria and provides value for the customer.

  • Partner with business stakeholders, developers, architects, QA automation engineers, SRE, DevOps, data teams, risk partners, designers, and operations teams to deliver capabilities from concept to production with clear acceptance criteria and measurable value.

  • Partner with QA, engineering, and DevOps teams to define the strategy for automated regression suites, continuous testing, test coverage metrics, release confidence, and CI/CD integration to improve delivery quality and reduce production risk.

  • Secure senior management prioritization and funding through compelling business cases, manage expectations and decision-making

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • 10+ years in product management, digital platform transformation, platform modernization, or technology product leadership, in large-scale enterprise environments.

  • Domain expertise in Financial Services, with knowledge of different asset classes and investment products.

  • 7+ years of experience in portfolio analytics-related roles driving end-to-end agenda.

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role, with demonstrable experience in agile product practices including roadmap ownership, outcome-based prioritization, Jira story writing, requirements management, acceptance criteria definition, process design, procedure authoring, and capacity planning.

  • Ability to translate engineering, QA, SRE, and operations needs into executive-ready narratives, investment cases, measurable OKRs, and delivery roadmaps.

  • Demonstrated experience defining product strategy for automated regression suites, quality engineering practices, CI/CD-integrated testing, test coverage measurement, defect triage, and release readiness governance.

  • Strong understanding of scalable platform architecture concepts, including reusable services, APIs, data quality, cloud-native design, resilience, performance, security, and AI-ready data and integration foundations.

  • Experience driving platform observability capabilities, including telemetry standards, logs, metrics, traces, alerting, dashboards, incident analytics, SLOs/SLIs, and operational health reporting.

  • Exceptional communication: executive storytelling, structured problem-solving, and stakeholder negotiation.

  • Organized and effective execution – work independently, set and manage expectations, and proactively manage efforts across multiple teams with effective communication.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or other Product certification preferred.

  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Bloomberg, Factset, and MS Office.

title: Senior Strategic Communication Specialist
description:
Overview

Join a Company Where You Can Make a Real Impact – and Own a Piece of the Future

Are you energized by the idea of helping a company grow smarter, serve our customers better, and connect more deeply? Do you thrive in an environment where your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your work drives real results? If so, we’d love to meet you.

We’re a mid-sized, employee-owned company on a mission to create meaningful value for both our employees and our customers. That means we’re not just looking for someone to fill a seat — we’re looking for someone who wants to build, innovate, and evolve with us.

Our company primarily serves the Navy and other Department of Defense clients, offering a dynamic environment where your expertise will make a difference.

About the Role

AVIAN is seeking a motivated and proactive Senior Strategic Communication Specialist to provide support to a Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) government customer. You will join a communication team in creating communication and multimedia products for internal and external audiences. Exceptional attention to detail and appetite for innovation are musts.

You will join AVIAN’s cadre of creative professionals who specialize in strategic communication, graphic design, marketing, multimedia production and more. Our creative team supports each other through constructive peer reviews, shares professional resources and regularly gathers for continuing education sessions.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Develop responses, provide planning, manage, and brief the findings in response to Congressional, Department of Defense (DoD), other Government agencies, media, industry inquiries and audits.
  • Coordinate with the Program Executive Office public affairs officer to facilitate communications between the media, squadrons, industry partners, NAVAIR IPTs (Integrated Product Teams) and other agencies by providing specialized communications.
  • Create, maintain and implement communications plans.
  • Advise leadership on program messaging.
  • Produce and deliver effective internal and external stakeholder communications using the Adobe Creative Suite and Microsoft Office Suite as well as other current industry software.
  • Craft content for briefs; communications plans and crisis media response planning; media query responses; key messages; press releases; feature articles; award packages; talking points/speeches; social media posts; etc.
  • Support public relations to include, but not limited to senior leadership interview preparation, media training, event planning/coordination, protocol activities, and engage in promoting or creating an intended public image for individuals, groups, or organizations.
  • Design multimedia products to include, but not limited to infographics, illustrations, logos/branding, web content development, wireframe and web page mockups, prototyping, publication design, fact sheets, photography, digital image editing, museum-quality wall displays, tradeshow displays and coordination.
  • Candidate must be a flexible team player and self-starter possessing excellent organizational skills. The ideal individual will have the ability to function in a team environment or autonomously, manage competing priorities, and be able to meet critical project schedules.
  • Selected candidate must be able to handle several tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel occasionally is preferred.
  • This is a hybrid position.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • MA/MS degree plus 13 years work experience performing duties described in responsibilities.
  • Bachelor’s Degree plus two (2) years additional work experience performing duties described in the functional description of the labor category may be substituted for a Master’s Degree.

Desired Experience:

  • Two years of experience supporting NAVAIR.
  • Microsoft Teams and SharePoint experience
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense security clearance.

title: UTIA Sub-Award Coordinator - Office of Sponsored Programs
description:
The UT Institute of Agriculture is seeking an Associate Subaward Coordinator to support the administration of sponsored projects that advance research, Extension, teaching, and service across Tennessee and beyond. This position plays an important role in helping faculty and staff manage subaward agreements accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with sponsor, federal, state, and university requirements.

This is a strong opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys research administration, problem-solving, customer service, and working with a wide range of internal and external partners. The successful candidate will coordinate subaward agreements, support subrecipient monitoring, maintain accurate records, and provide guidance to principal investigators, departmental staff, and partner organizations.

The Associate Subaward Coordinator will coordinate the subaward process from request through execution, monitoring, modification, and closeout. Core responsibilities include:

  • Coordinate the preparation, review, routing, issuance, modification, and closeout of incoming and outgoing subaward agreements.
  • Review subaward requests for completeness, accuracy, allowability, and compliance with sponsor requirements and university policies.
  • Collect required documentation and supporting materials for subaward actions.
  • Track subaward status and move agreements and modifications through the process in a timely manner.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records in university research administration systems.
  • Submit Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act reports through SAM.gov as required.
  • Review subrecipient compliance documentation, certifications, audit reports, and required assurances.
  • Conduct and document subrecipient risk assessments in accordance with applicable federal regulations and university requirements.
  • Identify and escalate compliance concerns and help coordinate appropriate follow-up with university offices.
  • Communicate with principal investigators, departmental business staff, Sponsored Projects Accounting, central research administration offices, external subrecipient organizations, and sponsoring agencies.
  • Provide guidance on subaward requirements, documentation, and administrative processes.
  • Serve as a resource for complex or escalated subaward and agreement questions.
  • Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing for team members and administrative staff.
  • Assist with process improvement efforts, reports, procedural guides, training materials, and other sponsored projects initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional who can manage detailed administrative and compliance work while providing clear, responsive service to campus and external partners. The ideal candidate will be able to organize work, meet deadlines, interpret requirements, and communicate effectively with individuals who have varying levels of experience with sponsored projects administration.

Successful candidates will bring:

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when working with sensitive information.
  • Ability to interpret and apply policies, procedures, regulations, and agreement terms.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with faculty, staff, central offices, and external partners.
  • Interest in continuous improvement, training, and practical problem-solving.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and enterprise business systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may substitute for the degree where permitted.
  • Three years of progressively responsible experience in sponsored projects administration, grants administration, research administration, contracts administration, compliance, finance, higher education administration, or a closely related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree.
  • Five years of progressively responsible experience in sponsored projects administration, grants administration, research administration, contracts and subawards administration, compliance, finance, higher education administration, or a closely related field.
  • Experience with subawards, subrecipient monitoring, risk assessment, or sponsored research agreements.
  • Knowledge of Uniform Guidance, federal sponsor requirements, and university research administration processes.
  • Experience with federal sponsors such as USDA, NIH, NSF, DOE, or similar agencies.
  • Experience using research administration or financial systems such as Cayuse, Huron, DASH, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support operational efficiencies.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume workload in a complex research or higher education environment.

Work Location and Schedule

This position is located in Knoxville, Tennessee. The work arrangement may be onsite, hybrid, or remote as approved by the hiring department and based on business needs. Any approved remote or hybrid arrangement will include expectations for availability, communication, service delivery, and any required onsite presence.

Compensation and Benefits

UT market range: MR 11

Anticipated hiring range: $66,000 - $75,000

The University of Tennessee offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include health, dental, and vision insurance; retirement options; paid time off; tuition benefits; well-being resources; and other employee programs. More information is available through UT Human Resources and the UT System benefits resources.

Application Instructions

To apply, please submit an application with the following materials:

  • Resume
  • Cover letter

To be assured of full consideration, completed applications with all requested materials should be submitted on or before August 21, 2026

Why Join UTIA Sponsored Projects?

The University of Tennessee Institute of Agriculture serves the state through teaching, research, and outreach in agriculture, natural resources, veterinary medicine, family and consumer sciences, and related fields. UTIA Sponsored Projects supports faculty and staff as they pursue and manage externally funded activities from federal, state, private, and other sponsors.

In this role, you will contribute to work that supports discovery, innovation, and public service while helping ensure sponsored projects are administered responsibly and effectively. You will be part of a professional environment that values accuracy, service, collaboration, continuous improvement, and compliance.

About the UT Institute of Agriculture

The University of Tennessee Institute of Agriculture provides teaching, research, and outreach that support agriculture, natural resources, families, communities, and the state of Tennessee. UTIA includes UT AgResearch, UT Extension, the Herbert College of Agriculture, and the College of Veterinary Medicine, with work that reaches communities across Tennessee and beyond.

UTIA Sponsored Projects supports the administration of sponsored activities and helps ensure effective, compliant management of sponsored project agreements and related research administration processes.

title: Temp Research Associate, School of Natural Resources - UTIA
description:
The research associate will work on a project focused on non-thermal plasma-assisted methane partial oxidation to methanol. The position will involve experimental reactor operation, product analysis, catalyst/material characterization, data organization, and coordination with graduate and undergraduate students in the research group.

The Research Associate will assist with the design, operation, and optimization of dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) plasma reactors for methane partial oxidation studies. Responsibilities will include preparing and testing catalyst/material samples, conducting plasma reaction experiments, monitoring reaction conditions, and analyzing gas and liquid products using gas chromatography and related analytical methods.

The associate will also support catalyst and material characterization using facilities available at the University of Tennessee and collaborating institutions. Relevant techniques may include X-ray diffraction (XRD), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier-transform spectroscopy (DRIFTS), chemisorption, and other surface or structural characterization methods such as XPS and XAS as needed. The position may also involve assisting with synchrotron-based measurements at national user facilities, such as NSLS-II or SSRL, including sample preparation, travel for beamtime experiments, data collection, and preliminary data analysis.

Additional responsibilities include maintaining accurate laboratory records, organizing experimental data, preparing figures and summaries for group discussions, contributing to manuscripts or reports when appropriate, and helping maintain safe and organized laboratory operations. The research associate will also work collaboratively with Ph.D. and undergraduate students in the group, including providing technical guidance and assisting with experimental training as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Master or Ph.D. degree in Chemical Engineering or related fields.

  • Experience: No working experience required

  • Prior research experience in catalysis, reaction engineering, plasma-assisted chemical conversion, materials characterization, electrochemistry, or a related field.

  • Comfortable working in a laboratory environment, following safety protocols, maintaining detailed records, and communicating research progress clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: Ph.D. degree in Chemical Engineering or related fields.

  • Experience: No working experience required

  • Research experience with gas chromatography, plasma reactors, heterogeneous catalysis, methane conversion, catalyst synthesis, and materials characterization techniques such as XRD, TEM, DRIFTS, XPS, XAS, or chemisorption.

  • Experience at synchrotron facilities with in situ/operando characterization.

Work Location

  • Location: Center for Renewable Carbon, Knoxville, TN

title: Strategy and Execution Lead - Lambda Cloud
description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

*Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.


Lambda Cloud delivers critical GPU compute to developers, enterprises, and AI-native startups. Reporting to the Head of Cloud Strategy, the Strategy and Execution Lead sets our operating cadence and builds the machinery to scale the business. This is a mid-to-senior IC role for someone who wants to build with a clear path to grow as the business scales. 12 months in, the systems you built run themselves and you've moved on to the next hard thing.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Lambda Cloud’s weekly, monthly and quarterly operating cadence across business review and planning.

  • Own the financial models that drive our strategic decisions (what we buy, where it goes, how we package it)

  • Build the business unit's P&L and operating metrics in collaboration with finance. This is how we evaluate and improve profitability.

  • Pilot and establish the process for requesting long-term capital investment in foundational projects.

  • Build the demand forecast system that optimizes what gets deployed when.

  • Operate at the seams with other teams such as supply, product, pricing, and support. Turn ad-hoc work such as deal pricing into well-understood and durable operating agreements.

  • Keep the system efficient as it scales. Reduce manual overhead and simplify business processes in ways our customers won’t see but the business will feel such as billing automation.

You

  • 5+ years (or 4+ with an advanced degree) spanning strategy, business operations, finance or revenue operations.

  • You’ve built decision-grade financial models from the ground up with incomplete data. You can defend your assumptions and verify thoroughly before you put your name on a number.

  • You lead cross-functionally without formal authority. You’ve gotten partner teams like supply, product, pricing, or finance moving in the same direction with a clear outcome.

  • You are comfortable in the details of operational systems and process design. You’ve mapped and fixed broken workflows.

  • You're an owner. You carry problems to a clear outcome and put your name on the result.

  • You communicate crisply and have partnered credibly across peer teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • You've started rebuilding some of your own work with AI and want to go much further.

  • You’ve done BizOps, Finance, or RevOps at a high-growth cloud, infrastructure, or hardware company.

  • Regularly presented to executive leadership

  • Commercial fluency across sales motions, deal structures, and pricing.

  • Exposure to capacity planning or capex allocation in the millions. Even better if billions.

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you make. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the food you sample. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

We are looking for a Technical Product Manager to join our Customer Service Platform team. In this role, you will own and evolve the foundational platform capabilities that power Customer Service operations at global scale, with a particular focus on our third-party agent desktop experiences and shared platform services.

Customer Service interactions are increasingly complex, time-sensitive and multi-step, often spanning several Booking.com products and services. You will help transform a fragmented tooling landscape into a unified, reliable and scalable platform that enables support teams to deliver fast, consistent and high-quality service experiences.

You will operate at the centre of a multi-year transformation to modernise our Customer Service landscape. Working across product, engineering, architecture, operations, security, data and external partners, you will ensure architectural coherence, capability reuse, operational stability and sustainable scaling.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence and no direct people-management responsibility.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties

  • Own and lead the Platform Enablement team’s product strategy, roadmap, and end‑to‑end delivery.

  • Align and adapt the team’s roadmap to the broader tech modernisation, company strategy, and architecture.

  • Define, track, and report clear product and engineering metrics to transparently communicate impact to stakeholders and senior leadership.

  • Improve platform reliability, availability, resilience and performance so the ecosystem can operate dependably at global scale.

  • Translate business and technical needs into a prioritised, technically grounded backlog that maximises impact.

  • Engage stakeholders across CS and other business units to implement changes, ensure operationalisation and measure impact.

  • Partner with engineers, data engineering, product teams and external third-party vendors to shape solutions and ship high‑quality, scalable capabilities, and performance stability.

Role Qualifications and Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years in technical Product Management, having managed large scale technical / platform products.

  • Proven ability to manage technical roadmaps, address technical debt and balance short-term delivery with long-term platform and product health.

  • Ability to articulate complex technical concepts as a clear and compelling narrative to non technical stakeholders

  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills. Clearly communicate with business and technical stakeholders at all levels.

  • Strong product judgement and the ability to balance customer, business and technical needs.

  • Excellent prioritisation skills in time-critical situations while balancing customer & business needs.

  • An analytical orientation and strong problem-solving skills demonstrated by the ability to structure issues and analyse alternative solutions.

  • Team player with a bottom-up ideation process

  • Experience with third-party enterprise platforms and vendor management is an advantage.



Benefits & Perks: Global Impact, Personal Relevance

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parental (22-weeks paid leave), grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, working from home furniture and ergonomic support, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)

  • A beautiful sustainable HQ Campus in Amsterdam, that offers on-site meals, coffee, and snacks, multi-faith and breastfeeding rooms at the office

  • Commuting allowance and bike reimbursement scheme

  • Discounts & Wallet credits to spend on our products, upgrade to Booking.com Genius Level 3, and friends & family Booking.com discount vouchers

  • Free access to online learning platforms, development and mentorship programs

  • Global Employee Assistance Program, free Headspace membership

DEI: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at Booking.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just create a unique workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone.”

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable adjustments to participate in the interview process. Please contact us to request adjustments.



Career Development Opportunities

  • Bi-annual performance conversations, company-wide mentoring program, and internal development opportunities

  • Unlimited access to online learning platforms: Udemy, Coursera, LinkedIn learning, O'reilly

Application Process

  • The interview process will entail a total of 4 interviews, all conducted via Zoom video conferencing.

  • This role does not come with relocation assistance.

Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.

title: SharePoint Developer
description:
Overview

Buzzi Unicem USA is one of the leading cement manufacturing companies in the United States. With over 1,500 valued employees, Buzzi Unicem USA manufactures and distributes its cement products throughout the Midwest, Southwest, Northeast and Southeast regions of the country. Globally, Buzzi Unicem SpA operates in 14 countries and employs almost 10,000 people. We are passionate about sustainably producing our cement products for the benefit of society by providing the foundation for crucial infrastructure projects such as roads, bridges, tunnels, airports, dams, and residential and industrial buildings.

Our commitment to positively contributing to society is a core principle for our business, and the reason we focus heavily on sustainable development. As part of our corporate culture, we recognize our role in meeting the current generation’s needs, while preserving environmental quality and protecting the needs of future generations.

Additionally, quality serves as the foundation of the way we do business at Buzzi Unicem USA. We have established at all our production sites, quality targets for our products that meet not only local regulatory standards but also our customer requirements.

Buzzi Unicem USA strives to provide a corporate culture supporting career growth through strong leadership and development planning. We offer a competitive salary, along with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits. Plus, our benefits include flexible spending accounts, supplemental life insurance and other voluntary benefits – such as accident and critical illness. We also provide a 401(k) savings plan, Employee Assistance Program, a tuition reimbursement program, professional development and advancement opportunities.

Join our team, be part of the solution, support evolving innovations, and help us continue providing quality products, all while being supported by strong leadership and a comprehensive and competitive benefits program.

Responsibilities

Site Architecture and Design

  • Build and maintain SharePoint Online site collections, hub sites, and communication/team sites
  • Design information architecture including content structure, navigation, and governance.
  • Collaborate closely with the Modern Workplace Administrator to ensure platform governance.

List and Library Configuration

  • Design SharePoint lists and document libraries with appropriate columns, content types, views, and metadata.
  • Establish foundational data structures that support Power Automate flows and Power Apps.

Power Automate/Apps Workflow Development

  • Build automated workflows for approvals, notifications, document routing, and data sync.
  • Identify and prioritize business processes suitable for automation.
  • Build Power Apps forms to replace default SharePoint list forms.

Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Troubleshoot, enhance, and optimize existing apps and workflows.
  • Provide technical support to business users and help resolve Power Platform-related issues.
  • Review user feedback and implement updates that improve usability and performance.
  • Identify automation opportunities and propose new solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience developing SharePoint Online solutions in a Microsoft 365 environment.
  • Solid understanding of SharePoint site architecture, lists, libraries, content types, and metadata.
  • Experience managing SharePoint permissions, sharing policies, and governance standards.
  • Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Microsoft certifications such as PL‑400
  • Experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx) and modern web development technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, React).
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) and how it underpins SharePoint and Power Platform.

  • Experience with Power Apps model-driven applications and Dataverse.

  • Experience designing relational data models and working with connectors.

  • Familiarity with PowerShell or scripting for automation tasks.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview and data governance concepts.

  • Experience working alongside or in a Microsoft 365 / Modern Workplace Administrator capacity.

  • Strong communication and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.

walls, windows, mirrors, and floors as necessary

recovery to ensure guest satisfaction, notify team leader on shift of any experienced issues

procedures as needed
What we need from you
• Excellent RSA serves skills
• Fitness – you’ll be on your feet most of the day with lots of bending and kneeling
• Strength –sometimes you’ll need to lift, push or pull big objects like barrels & crates up to 23 kg

training

the minimum age required and fluent in the local language

How do I deliver this?


We genuinely care about people, and we show this through living out our promise of True
Hospitality each and every day. It’s what connects every colleague in all IHG® hotels.

core service skills.


• True Attitude: being caring, wanting to make a positive difference, and building genuine

and caring manner


There’s so much more to the job than we can capture here. It’s simply about creating great
experiences, doing the right thing and understanding people.

title: FIELD SERVICE TECH
description:
Hugg & Hall Equipment Company is looking for someone with mechanical knowledge and customer service skills to join our team as a Service Mechanic in the field. We are a full-service equipment company specializing in industrial and construction equipment since 1956. More information about us can be found below or on our website at www.hugghall.com.

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Service Mechanic functions as part of the Service Team and is responsible for the care of various types of customer and company-owned equipment.

In this role, you will:

  • Troubleshoot and repair a variety of equipment at various customer locations to bring each unit back to operational and safety standards.
  • Effectively communicate with all involved parties, including Salespeople, Coordinators, Managers, and Customers, about possible downtime and job progress updates.
  • Operate in a safe, efficient manner with minimal supervision to decrease equipment downtime while also maintaining safe working standards both on-site and during the operation of company vehicles.

COMPENSATION/BENEFITS

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Quarterly Performance Bonuses
  • Overtime after 8 hours per day
  • Factory Training
  • Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurances, plus several supplemental benefits)
  • Generous PTO Plan
  • Paid Holidays
  • 401k with company match

REQUIREMENTS

  • minimum 1 year of mechanical training/education, and/or experience in a related field
  • possessing or ability to obtain a complete line of tools, including specialized tools needed to complete the job at the customer site
  • minimum 21 years of age
  • clean driving record
  • High school diploma or equivalent

SKILLS THAT WILL SET YOU UP FOR SUCCESS MAY INCLUDE:

  • above average communication skills
  • ability to read or be trained in reading schematics
  • ability to accomplish duties with accuracy and timeliness
  • ability to work independently with minimal supervision

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

This position:

  • will be working in operating facilities and outdoors, traveling to customer locations. The employee will encounter varying weather conditions and temperatures. The normal auto hazards will apply.
  • will be frequently working on equipment with potential hazards where appropriate safety equipment and practices are required.
  • must be able to lift 50 pounds. Occasionally may be required to lift items weighing up to 100 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 100 pounds.
  • requires standing, walking, twisting, climbing, and crawling.
  • requires bending, stooping, kneeling, or squatting handling/fingering on a daily basis.
  • requires driving a van/truck to and from customer locations
  • must be able to wear safety glasses and safety shoes.
  • must be medically capable of performing all aspects of the job with the maximum amount of safety.

[This position is deemed a Safety Sensitive job for purposes of the Arkansas Medical Marijuana Amendment, the Oklahoma Medical Marijuana and Patient Protection Act and the Louisiana Therapeutic Marijuana Act.]

ABOUT US:

Hugg & Hall Equipment Company is a full-service equipment dealer headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas since 1956. With 17 locations across Arkansas, Oklahoma, and Louisiana and further servicing the surrounding states, we strive to equip our customers for success. Through our Sales, Rental, Parts, and Service departments, we offer cutting-edge equipment, world-class service, and an unsurpassed parts inventory. From job sites to warehouses, we provide our customers with all their construction, industrial, aerial, and material-handling needs, helping them to minimize downtime and maximize productivity. As an employer of over 850, we are keen on building a team that is safe, productive, honest, dependable, and responsible. If you want to build a career with a company where you are valued and well-trained, join us at Hugg & Hall.

Hugg & Hall Equipment Company is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including sexual orientation and gender identity), age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. We place Safety First.

(Initial hire requires passing of pre-employment background check, physical abilities test, drug test and driving record)

title: Intern, Depository Services
description:

title: Petroleum Scientist 3 (Permitting & Compliance)
description:
About this Job

The Office of Permitting and Compliance (OPC) oversees all permitting and regulatory functions within the Department, ensuring clarity, consistency, and regulatory integrity. By streamlining processes, accelerating permitting timelines and enhancing data-driven decision-making, the Office ensures compliance with environmental standards while supporting responsible economic development.

The Petroleum Scientist 3 performs high level work as an advisor and state expert to agency staff and the public on matters relating to Class I, II, III, and V injection, storage and disposal well siting, permitting, and monitoring as well as related environmental and remediation matters in the state.

Minimum Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in a geoscience field or engineering plus two years of experience in the evaluation of oil and gas drilling, oil and gas production and/or oil and gas transportation, mining engineering or geology; OR

A master's degree in a geoscience field or engineering plus one year of the required specialized experience; OR

A doctorate in a geoscience field or engineering.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

This Petroleum Scientist 3 position is located within the Engineering Division of the Office Permitting & Compliance and is located in Baton Rouge, LA. The incumbent in this position reports to the Petroleum Scientist Supervisor. All work is performed in accordance with departmental policies, procedures, rules, and regulations.

Duties include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Permit applications for Class I, II, III, V, or VI subsurface injection/disposal wells require the submission of complex geologic subsurface structure and isopach maps, etc.
  • Functions as principal assistant to their supervisor in coordinating and directing technical unit activities and managerial functions as they relate to the total geological program of the Division.
  • Mentors and reviews of work performed by lower level petroleum scientists doing technical geological analyses and evaluations and, on a project basis, sub-professional staff.
  • Thoroughly inspects and monitors by-product operations, including hazardous waste injection wells, solution mining of salt, hydrocarbon storage in solution-mined salt caverns, etc.
  • Disseminates information, orally and written, and advises the general public, industry representatives, consultants, Federal, State, Parish, etc. on various geological matters.
  • Provides guidance and direction on geological issues and serves in an advisory capacity during conferences and meetings with representatives.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

POSITION-SPECIFIC DETAILS:

Appointment Type: This position may be filled as a fulltime Classified Probationary appointment or may be filled as a Job Appointment (In the event that funds become available for a permanent position, the employee may be converted to a probational appointment).

Work Schedule: Work hours are flexible.

Compensation: The salary offered will be determined based on qualifications and experience. This position is eligible for premium pay of up to $2.00 per hour for licensed employees. A Special Entrance Rate (SER) is offered to qualified applicants.

Louisiana is a State As a Model Employer (SAME) that supports the recruitment, hiring, and retention of individuals with disabilities.

How To Apply:

No Civil Service test score is required in order to be considered for this vacancy.

To apply for this vacancy, click on the “Apply” link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page.

* Information to support your eligibility for the position must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections. Applications may be rejected if incomplete.

For further information about this vacancy contact:

Human Resources

Department of Conservation and Energy

PO Box 94396

Baton Rouge, LA 70804-9396
